41475890.sourceTitle: RIC-specific cytoprotective profile mediated by microglia in a mouse model of acute ischaemic stroke.
41475890.sourceAbstract: Background: Remote ischaemic conditioning (RIC) is an endogenous neuroprotective strategy involving repeated, transient occlusion of a limb artery to reduce ischaemic injury at a distant site. We investigated the effects of RIC in a mouse model of focal cerebral ischaemia induced by distal transient middle cerebral artery occlusion (tMCAO). Animals were randomised into three groups: Stroke (tMCAO, 60 min), Stroke+remote ischaemic preconditioning (RIPerC) (RIC applied during ischaemia) and Stroke+remote ischaemic postconditioning (RIPostC) (RIC initiated 10 min after reperfusion). The RIC protocol consisted of three cycles of 5-minute hindlimb ischaemia followed by 5-minute reperfusion. Results: At 72 hours postischaemia, both RIPerC and RIPostC significantly reduced the infarct volumes in male and female mice. In males, infarct size decreased from 6.31 ± 0.28% (Stroke) to 3.77 ± 0.47% (RIPerC, p<0.0025) and 4.00 ± 0.40% (RIPostC, p<0.0061). However, the RIPerC+RIPostC group significantly increased the infarct volume compared with the Stroke group (8.41± 0.72%). In females, reductions were greater: from 6.69±0.46% (Stroke) to 2.95 ± 0.34% (RIPerC, p<0.0001) and 2.96 ± 0.32% (RIPostC, p<0.0001). Functional recovery was improved, particularly with RIPostC, correlating with infarct size reduction (Pearson’s r=0.5505 in males, r=0.7313 in females). Apoptosis was reduced by over 50% with both treatments, and microglial phagocytic activity (cluster of differentiation 68+/Iba1+ (ionised calcium binding adaptor molecule 1)) increased significantly. Microglial depletion using PLX3397 (71.3% reduction in Iba1+ cells) worsened ischaemic injury, yet RIC preserved its protective effects, suggesting additional microglia-independent mechanisms. Furthermore, RIC enhanced neurogenesis in the subventricular zone and infarct core (doublecortin marker+ cells doubled versus Stroke), with a marked proliferative response in female hippocampi (Ki67+ cells increased by 127%). Conclusion: These findings reveal sex-specific efficacy of RIC, with mechanistic insights obtained in male animals suggesting a dual mode of action via modulation of microglial function and promotion of endogenous neurorepair pathways.

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 雄鼠梗死体积由对照6.31%降至缺血期处理3.77%、再灌注后处理4.00%；雌鼠由6.69%降至2.95%、2.96%。但联合两时段处理组梗死增至8.41%，并非叠加获益。两种单独处理凋亡下降超过50%，吞噬及神经发生指标增加。耗减71.3%的Iba1阳性细胞虽加重损伤，RIC仍保持保护，提示还存在小胶质细胞以外机制。

42896130.sourceTitle: Intranasal Delivery of an Antioxidant Nanoassembly for Cerebral Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury via Drd2/β-arrestin2/ERK Signaling.
42896130.sourceAbstract: Cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury (CIRI) is caused by reduced cerebral blood flow, leading to excessive oxidative stress and neurological deficits. Curcumin (Cur) is a promising therapeutic agent, but its antioxidant activity is limited by low bioavailability and poor brain penetration. Herein, an intranasal delivery strategy using a tetrahedral framework nucleic acid (tFNAs)-Cur nanoassembly (tFNAs-Cur) was employed for CIRI treatment. tFNAs-Cur was synthesized through self-assembly, achieving a high Cur loading efficiency of 87% and exhibiting potent scavenging activity against reactive oxygen species (ROS) including O2·-, ·OH, and H2O2. In vitro studies showed that tFNAs-Cur inhibited oxygen glucose deprivation/reoxygenation-induced ROS elevation of cytoplasm and mitochondria, and enhanced proliferation and migration of SH-SY5Y cells. In vivo studies demonstrated that intranasal administration of tFNAs-Cur reduced cerebral infarct volume, enhanced neuronal survival, and improved neurological and behavioral outcomes in middle cerebral artery occlusion rats. Further mechanistic investigation using RNA sequencing revealed that tFNAs-Cur exerted its effects by activating the Drd2/β-arrestin2/ERK signaling, thereby improving mitochondrial function and upregulating BDNF levels. Furthermore, hemolysis assays, serum biochemical measurements, and histopathological analyses demonstrated that tFNAs-Cur possessed a favorable biosafety profile both ex vivo and in vivo. This study provides an intranasal antioxidant nanoassembly strategy for CIRI and holds potential for clinical translation.

42896704.sourceTitle: Role and mechanism of ATF6-mediated endoplasmic reticulum stress in ITLN-1 against cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury.
42896704.sourceAbstract:
AIMS: Intelectin-1 (ITLN-1), a novel adipocytokine, exerts neuroprotective effects against cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury (CIRI), yet its molecular mechanisms remain unclear. This study focused on activating transcription factor 6 (ATF6), a key endoplasmic reticulum stress sensor, to explore its role in CIRI-induced neuronal injury and determine whether ITLN-1 mediates neuroprotection through ATF6 regulation.

MATERIALS AND METHODS: We established an N2a cell hypoxia/reoxygenation (H/R) model and a mouse middle cerebral artery occlusion (MCAO) model. Using protein-protein molecular docking, in situ proximity ligation assay, Western blotting, mitochondrial membrane potential assays, and TUNEL staining, we investigated ATF6 activation in neuronal apoptosis and its upstream regulatory mechanisms.

KEY FINDINGS: H/R injury markedly induced ATF6 activation in N2a cells, triggering mitochondrial dysfunction and promoting apoptosis. ATF6 overexpression further aggravated these effects, supporting its critical pathogenic role in CIRI. Mechanistic analyses revealed that ITLN-1 physically associates with ATF6. Both ITLN-1 overexpression and exogenous recombinant ITLN-1 administration significantly suppressed excessive ATF6 activation, modulated the JNK signaling pathway, improved cell viability, reduced intracellular calcium overload and reactive oxygen species accumulation, and attenuated neuronal apoptosis. In vivo, ITLN-1 ameliorated neurological deficits, reduced neuronal damage, and alleviated demyelination, whereas ITLN-1 knockdown produced opposite effects.

SIGNIFICANCE: Excessive ATF6 activation underlies CIRI-induced neuronal injury. ITLN-1 exerts neuroprotection by inhibiting ATF6 and modulating JNK signaling, thereby alleviating mitochondrial dysfunction and reducing apoptosis. These findings highlight the ITLN-1/ATF6 axis as a promising therapeutic target for ischemic stroke.

sections.text: 研究脂肪细胞因子Intelectin-1（ITLN-1）是否通过调节内质网应激感受器ATF6，减轻脑缺血再灌注所致神经元损伤。

sections.heading: 主要结果

42905928.sourceTitle: Stage-Associated Efficacy of Systemically Administered Neural Stem Cell-Derived Exosomes in Ischemic Stroke through the Prevention of Cx43 Degradation.
42905928.sourceAbstract: Ischemic stroke pathology is highly dynamic, making the optimal timing for biological interventions highly elusive. This study investigated the stage-associated therapeutic efficacy of neural stem cell-derived exosomes (NSC-Exos) for cerebral ischemia-reperfusion. The in vivo evaluations identified a restricted therapeutic window closely associated with the temporal evolution of the ischemic microenvironment. Early exosome intervention (4 or 24 h post-ischemia) significantly reduced infarct volume, restored blood-brain barrier integrity, and improved neurological functional recovery. In contrast, delayed administration (48 h) failed to reduce the mortality rate and provide meaningful neuroprotection. To examine the molecular basis of this time dependence, we integrated temporal proteomic profiling of the ischemic penumbra with small RNA sequencing of NSC-Exos. The analytical and functional data suggest that early NSC-Exo delivery transfers miR-9-5p to suppress Nedd4 expression, thereby restoring the Connexin 43 protein pool and stabilizing the astrocytic network to halt initial microenvironmental collapse. Collectively, this study underscores the critical importance of intervention timing and provides a potential translational strategy for utilizing NSC-Exos as a targeted, stage-specific therapy in acute ischemic stroke.

sections.text: 研究神经干细胞来源外泌体（NSC-Exos）对脑缺血再灌注的作用是否依赖给药时机，并寻找这种阶段性差异的分子解释。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 在体内模型比较缺血后4、24和48小时的系统性外泌体干预；联合缺血半暗带时间序列蛋白组学与外泌体小RNA测序，再通过功能实验研究miR-9-5p、Nedd4及连接蛋白Cx43通路。摘要未提供动物种属、样本量或具体效应数值。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 4或24小时早期给药与梗死体积减少、血脑屏障完整性恢复及神经功能改善相关；48小时延迟给药未能降低死亡率或提供有意义的神经保护。分析与功能结果提示，早期外泌体递送miR-9-5p，抑制Nedd4，恢复Cx43蛋白储备并稳定星形胶质细胞网络。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 关键发现是干预时间窗，而不是证明外泌体在任意时间都有效。该结果属于前临床机制证据；Cx43蛋白保存与网络稳定不能直接等同于已证实神经血管电信号功能改善，临床给药安全性、剂量和窗口仍待验证。

42906674.sourceTitle: Multiscale heterostructured Mg-2 Zn alloy for biodegradable implants: Coordinated strength-ductility, moderate degradation, and immunomodulation.
42906674.sourceAbstract: High-strength lean-alloy magnesium (Mg) has attracted extensive attention for orthopedic and vascular stent implants owing to its favorable biodegradability and biocompatibility. However, while retaining the chemical composition of specimens and ensuring high biosafety, the major challenge is to overcome the strength-ductility trade-off and achieve uniform degradation behavior. In this study, a lean Mg-2 wt% Zn alloy with balanced strength and ductility was fabricated via hot working. The alloy possessed a bimodal heterogeneous structure composed of fine-grained regions containing nanograins and nanotwins, as well as coarse-grained regions. It attained an ultimate tensile strength of approximately 350 MPa with an elongation of 13%. This heterostructured Mg-2Zn alloy exhibits better performance compared with the commercial rare-earth-containing WE43 alloy. Moreover, it demonstrated slow degradation rates (0.07 mm·year-1 in vitro and 0.11 mm·year-1 in vivo) driven by multi-phase interface effects. Furthermore, the heterostructured Mg-2 Zn alloy exhibited antibacterial activity in vitro and a relatively mild peri‑implant inflammatory response in vivo. This study differs from conventional rare-earth alloy strengthening strategies, clarifies the formation and regulation mechanisms of heterostructures, and provides theoretical and technical support for the clinical translation of high-performance biodegradable Mg alloys. STATEMENT OF SIGNIFICANCE: To address the bottleneck of balancing mechanical performance and biocompatibility in rare-earth-free magnesium (Mg) alloys for biodegradable temporary implants, this study employed a multi-pass hot-rolling process with an optimized final rolling temperature to produce the lean-alloyed Mg-2 Zn heterostructured alloy. The alloy achieved a reasonable combination of tensile strength (349 MPa) and elongation (13%), mitigating the common strength-ductility trade-off observed in Mg-2 Zn alloys. Metabolomic analysis showed that metal ions slowly released during alloy degradation could regulate biological energy metabolism, endowing the material with antibacterial activity in vitro and a relatively mild peri‑implant inflammatory response in vivo. This study clarified the mechanisms associated with heterostructure formation, strength-ductility synergistic strengthening, slow degradation, and biological metabolic regulation. It also provided experimental support for the research and development of high-performance rare-earth-free Mg-based biomaterials.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 在不依赖稀土强化的镁合金中，以Mg-2 wt% Zn和异质结构协调强度、延展性、降解及生物反应，面向骨科和血管支架等临时植入材料。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 通过多道次热轧及末道温度优化，形成含纳米晶/纳米孪晶细晶区与粗晶区的双峰异质组织。评价力学、体外及体内降解、体外抗菌、植入周围炎症，并通过代谢组学探索缓慢释放金属离子的生物作用。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 抗拉强度约349–350 MPa、伸长率13%，摘要报告相较商业含稀土WE43具有较好综合表现。体外降解约0.07 mm/年、体内0.11 mm/年；显示体外抗菌和相对温和的植入周围炎症。代谢组学提示降解释放离子与生物能量代谢调节相关。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 材料用于“植入物”不等于已经证明适用于血管支架。摘要未交代体内模型细节与临床结局，不能外推血管通畅、抗血栓或长期人体安全性；应进一步核对径向/疲劳性能、氢气析出及特定部位的降解支持期限。

42913965.sourceTitle: Pharmacological basis of Suhexiang Wan in ischemic stroke: identification and functional characterization of piperlongumine as a brain-distributed bioactive constituent associated with STAT3-mediated blood-brain barrier protection.
42913965.sourceAbstract:
ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Suhexiang Wan (SHXW) is a classical traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) formula that has been traditionally used for stroke-related disorders, including sudden loss of consciousness, neurological dysfunction, and hemiplegia. Although modern pharmacological studies have suggested its neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory properties, the brain-distributed constituents potentially associated with its therapeutic effects in ischemic stroke (IS) and the underlying molecular mechanisms remain unclear.

AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to elucidate the pharmacological basis of SHXW in IS by identifying brain-distributed constituents and investigating a candidate constituent potentially associated with its protective effects against cerebral ischemia/reperfusion injury (CIRI), with particular emphasis on blood-brain barrier (BBB) protection.

MATERIALS AND METHODS: SHXW-derived constituents detected in brain tissue under middle cerebral artery occlusion/reperfusion (MCAO/R) conditions were characterized using ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (UHPLC-MS/MS). Integrated network pharmacology analysis was performed to predict potential therapeutic targets and signaling pathways. Piperlongumine (PIP) was further confirmed and quantified in SHXW and brain tissue using an authentic standard-based LC-MS/MS approach. Molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, biophysical binding assays, and cellular target-engagement experiments were used to investigate the interaction between PIP and signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3). The protective effects and associated mechanisms were evaluated in a mouse MCAO/R model and an oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation (OGD/R)-induced brain microvascular endothelial cell injury model.

RESULTS: Among 1991 putatively annotated constituents of SHXW, 55 SHXW-derived constituents were detected in brain tissue under MCAO/R conditions. In the MCAO/R mouse model, SHXW significantly improved neurological deficits, reduced infarct volume and brain edema, decreased BBB permeability, and restored tight junction protein expression. Among the brain-detected constituents, PIP, a natural alkaloid derived from Piper longum L., was selected for further investigation based on its detection in brain tissue, network topology characteristics, predicted association with STAT3, and reported pharmacological relevance to ischemic injury. Authentic standard-based LC-MS/MS confirmed PIP in SHXW and brain tissue, with a PIP content of 48.21 ± 1.10 μg/g in SHXW and a brain concentration of 159.67 ± 8.37 ng/g at 2 h after SHXW administration. Biophysical and cellular target-engagement assays supported the interaction between PIP and STAT3. PIP partially recapitulated the protective effects of SHXW by alleviating neurological deficits, preserving BBB integrity, restoring endothelial barrier function, and suppressing STAT3-associated inflammatory responses. STAT3 knockdown partially phenocopied the endothelial protective effects of PIP, whereas restoration of STAT3 expression in STAT3-knockdown cells reversed the protective phenotype. PIP treatment attenuated the injury-associated changes following STAT3 restoration, supporting the functional involvement of STAT3-associated signaling in PIP-mediated BBB protection.

CONCLUSIONS: This study provides new insights into the pharmacological basis of SHXW in IS by integrating chemical profiling, brain distribution analysis, and pharmacological validation. SHXW exerted protective effects against CIRI and preserved BBB integrity. Among the SHXW-derived constituents detected in brain tissue, PIP was identified and functionally characterized as a bioactive candidate associated with BBB protection. The findings support the involvement of PIP-STAT3 interaction and STAT3-associated inflammatory signaling in PIP-mediated BBB protection. These results provide pharmacological evidence linking the traditional application of SHXW with its modern molecular mechanisms while highlighting brain-distribution-guided approaches for investigating the therapeutic basis of complex TCM formulas.

sections.text: 1991个推定注释成分中，有55种苏合香丸来源成分在缺血脑组织检出。标准品法确认PIP，丸剂含量48.21±1.10 μg/g，给药2小时脑浓度159.67±8.37 ng/g。苏合香丸减轻神经损伤、梗死、水肿及屏障通透性；PIP部分再现这些作用。结合和靶标实验支持PIP–STAT3相互作用，STAT3敲低部分模拟保护、恢复表达逆转相关表型，PIP可减轻恢复后的损伤变化。

42918390.sourceTitle: Outcomes of Total Endovascular Repair of Aortic Arch and Thoraco-abdominal Aortic Aneurysms in the International Multicenter Aortic Research Group in a Selected Group of Patients with Extensive Aortic Aneurysm Disease.
42918390.sourceAbstract:
OBJECTIVE: The aim of this study was to report outcomes of total endovascular aortic repair (TEAR) using arch branched endovascular aortic repair (aBEVAR) and thoraco-abdominal aortic aneurysm (TAAA) fenestrated branched endovascular aortic repair (FBEVAR).

METHODS: Clinical data from 16 participating centres in the International Multicenter Aortic Research Group from 2014 to 2024 were retrospectively analysed. All patients who underwent TEAR were included. The primary outcome was aortic related mortality (ARM). Secondary outcomes included stroke and or transient ischaemic attack (TIA), spinal cord ischaemia (SCI), and freedom from target artery (TA) instability, re-interventions, and new cardiovascular events (CVEs) within 1 year.

RESULTS: Of 98 patients scheduled for TEAR, 95 (97%) completed both stages, including 46 (48%) with chronic post-dissection aneurysms and 49 (52%) with degenerative aneurysms. A multistage approach with aBEVAR followed by TAAA FBEVAR was used in all patients, with a median interval between stages of 11 months (interquartile range [IQR] 5, 14). One (1%) rupture occurred between the staged procedures (successfully managed with off the shelf TAAA multibranch stent graft). Custom made and off the shelf TAAA FBEVAR devices were used in 79 (83%) and 16 (17%) patients, respectively. There were 12 (13%) stroke and or TIAs (aBEVAR, ten; TAAA FBEVAR, two); five (5%) had a modified Rankin Scale score > 3. Sixteen patients (17%) experienced SCI (aBEVAR, two; TAAA FBEVAR, 14) with three cases (3%) of paraplegia. Four patients (4%) died within thirty days; these were the only cases of ARM. Median follow up was 32 months (IQR 3, 61). Of 67 patients (71%) with available one year follow up, there were six (9%) with TA instability and five (7%) CVEs. Estimated three year survival was 79 ± 5% with a cumulative incidence of re-intervention of 31 ± 6%.

CONCLUSION: Multistage TEAR with aBEVAR followed by TAAA FBEVAR was associated with low ARM, re-intervention, and TA instability. Stroke and SCI remain significant and must be carefully weighed during patient selection and treatment.

sections.text: 研究广泛主动脉瘤患者接受主动脉弓分支腔内修复、继以胸腹主动脉开窗分支修复的分期全腔内治疗结果。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 国际主动脉研究协作组16中心回顾性分析2014–2024年病例。主要终点为主动脉相关死亡；其他终点含卒中/TIA、脊髓缺血、靶血管不稳定、再次干预及新发心血管事件。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 98例计划治疗者中95例完成两阶段，48%为慢性夹层后动脉瘤，52%为退行性瘤。阶段间中位11个月，期间1例破裂并成功处理。卒中或TIA共12例（13%），其中5例改良Rankin评分>3；脊髓缺血16例（17%），3例截瘫。30天死亡4例（4%），均为该队列的主动脉相关死亡。中位随访32个月；有1年资料的67例中，靶血管不稳定9%、心血管事件7%。估计3年生存79±5%，累计再干预31±6%。

sections.heading: 结论与局限

42918394.sourceTitle: Effect of Microvascular Disease on Re-amputation Risk after Unilateral Amputation due to Diabetes or Peripheral Arterial Disease: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
42918394.sourceAbstract:
OBJECTIVE: The aim of this study was to evaluate the association between manifestations of microvascular disease (MVD) and other factors on re-amputation risk within 12 months following incident unilateral lower extremity amputation.

METHODS: This was a retrospective cohort study of 8 924 patients with first unilateral transmetatarsal, transtibial, or transfemoral amputation secondary to diabetes and or peripheral arterial disease, identified through a Veterans Affairs database. Re-amputation was defined as any subsequent ipsilateral soft tissue or bony revision or amputation to a higher level. The presence of MVD was determined using a composite variable that required the involvement of each subcomponent (neuropathy, nephropathy, and retinopathy), and also by evaluating each of the subcomponent MVD variables separately. Twenty-nine additional risk factors were evaluated in relation to the primary outcome of re-amputation. A competing risk analysis estimated the cumulative incidence of re-amputation. The effect of risk factors on re-amputation risk was estimated by computing subdistribution hazard ratios (sub-HRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs).

RESULTS: The twelve month re-amputation risk was 38.0% (transmetatarsal), 27.2% (transtibial), and 14.1% (transfemoral). The combined MVD variable was not significantly associated with re-amputation risk. However, re-amputation after transmetatarsal amputation was significantly elevated in patients with retinopathy, leukocytosis, or those who were on kidney dialysis, with the highest risk in those with all three (sub-HR 2.2, 95% CI 1.8 - 2.6). Similarly, for transtibial patients, the risk was higher in the presence of retinopathy, leukocytosis, and kidney dialysis, and in those with a prior ipsilateral revascularisation and those on warfarin. The highest risk was observed in those with all factors present (sub-HR 2.1, 95% CI 1.6 - 2.7).

CONCLUSION: This study identified an important association between the pre-amputation diagnosis of retinopathy and risk for subsequent failure of primary healing and need for re-amputation. Presence of retinopathy should be considered when evaluating potential failure of healing during amputation level decisions.

sections.text: 研究糖尿病和/或外周动脉疾病患者首次单侧下肢截肢后，微血管病变及其他因素与12个月内再次截肢风险的关系。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 基于美国退伍军人事务数据库的回顾性队列，共8924例首次经跖骨、经胫骨或经股骨截肢患者。再次截肢包括同侧软组织/骨性修整及更高平面截肢。分别分析神经病、肾病、视网膜病及三者组成的复合变量，并用竞争风险模型评估另29项风险因素。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 12个月再次截肢风险在经跖骨、经胫骨、经股骨组分别为38.0%、27.2%、14.1%。复合微血管病变量与再次截肢无显著关联；但视网膜病、白细胞增多及透析与经跖骨截肢后风险升高相关，三项并存时亚分布HR为2.2（95%CI 1.8–2.6）。经胫骨组还涉及既往同侧血运重建和华法林，所有相关因素并存时亚分布HR为2.1（1.6–2.7）。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 不能笼统表述为“所有微血管病都会增加再次截肢”；阴性复合指标与阳性单项指标应分开理解。视网膜病可能是愈合风险标志，但数据库观察性关联不能证明因果，也不能单凭此指标决定截肢平面；退伍军人人群的外推性需评估。

42918463.sourceTitle: Essential oil from Angelica sinensis Radix attenuates ischemic stroke via the cGMP/PKG/MAPK pathway: insights from network pharmacology and molecular mechanism evaluation.
42918463.sourceAbstract:
ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: As a traditional herbal remedy, the root of Angelica sinensis has long been used to treat headaches, strokes, and dementia. As the primary active ingredient in A. sinensis, A. sinensis essential oil (ASEO) also plays a significant role in the therapy of stroke. Although ASEO has shown clear therapeutic effects, its specific mechanism of preventing ischemic stroke still needs to be further clarified.

AIM OF THE STUDY: Through network pharmacological analysis combined with in vitro and in vivo experimental verification, this study investigated the protective effects of ASEO against stroke and elucidated the underlying molecular regulatory mechanisms.

MATERIALS AND METHODS: Gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) was used to analyze the chemical composition of ASEO. Middle cerebral artery occlusion/reperfusion (MCAO/R) rats were administered different doses of ASEO to evaluate its therapeutic effects. The therapeutic effects were evaluated using behavioral, histopathological, and immunofluorescence assays. In addition, using network pharmacology techniques, the potential molecular mechanisms underlying the treatment of ischemic stroke with ASEO have been preliminarily elucidated. HT22 cells treated with oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation (OGD/R) were used as an in vitro model. Subsequently, the key signal transduction pathways involved in the therapeutic effects of ASEO against ischemic stroke were further validated using multiple experimental approaches, including enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), flow cytometry, Western blotting, pathway-specific pharmacological inhibition and PKG-specific siRNA knockdown.

RESULTS: Twenty-seven compounds were identified from ASEO by GC-MS. In vivo experiments demonstrated that ASEO treatment exerted significant protective effects on MCAO/R rats by improving impaired neurological function, reducing cerebral infarct volume, alleviating neuronal apoptosis, and modulating the expression of apoptotic proteins. Mechanistically, network pharmacology studies suggested that the protective mechanism of ASEO may involve the cGMP/PKG and MAPK signaling pathways. Subsequent experiments confirmed that ASEO inhibited neuronal apoptosis via the cGMP/PKG/MAPK axis both in vivo and in vitro. Importantly, both pharmacological inhibition and siRNA-mediated genetic knockdown of PKG significantly attenuated the protective effects of ASEO against OGD/R injury in HT22 cells.

CONCLUSION: ASEO exerts its anti-ischemic stroke effect by attenuating apoptosis via the cGMP/PKG/MAPK signaling pathway, providing a scientific foundation for its clinical application in ischemic stroke therapy.

42924849.sourceTitle: Outcomes of Intra-Arterial Urokinase After Endovascular Reperfusion for Acute Ischemic Stroke Due to Cardioembolism: A Secondary Analysis of the POST-UK Trial.
42924849.sourceAbstract:
BACKGROUND: Whether adjunctive intra-arterial thrombolysis improves outcomes in patients with acute ischemic stroke due to cardioembolism remains unclear. This study aimed to investigate the efficacy and safety of adjunctive intra-arterial urokinase in patients with acute ischemic stroke due to cardioembolism who achieved near-complete to complete reperfusion.

METHODS: This study was a secondary analysis of the POST-UK (Adjunctive Intra-Arterial Urokinase After Near-Complete to Complete Reperfusion for Acute Ischemic Stroke) trial, which was conducted from November 15, 2022, to March 29, 2024. Patients were randomly assigned to the intra-arterial urokinase group or the control group. The primary outcome was disability-free survival at 90 days, defined as a modified Rankin Scale score of 0 to 1. Safety outcomes included 90-day all-cause death, symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage and any intracranial hemorrhage within 48 hours.

RESULTS: Among 209 patients with cardioembolism (median age 73 [interquartile range, 63-81] years; 45.9% men), 106 were assigned to the control group and 103 to the intra-arterial urokinase group. Compared with the control group, adjunctive intra-arterial urokinase significantly increased the odds of disability-free survival at 90 days (adjusted risk ratio, 1.49 [95% CI, 1.08-2.06]; P=0.01; inverse probability of treatment weighting adjusted risk ratio, 1.47 [95% CI, 1.04-2.09]; P=0.03). No significant differences were found between groups in 90-day mortality rate, symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage, or any intracranial hemorrhage within 48 hours.

CONCLUSIONS: In patients with acute ischemic stroke due to cardioembolism who achieved near-complete to complete reperfusion, adjunctive intra-arterial urokinase significantly improved disability-free survival at 90 days without increasing the risk of death or intracranial hemorrhage.

sections.text: POST-UK随机试验的二次分析，分析其中209例心源性栓塞患者；103例分配尿激酶，106例对照。主要终点为90天无残疾生存，即改良Rankin评分0–1；安全终点为90天全因死亡及48小时内症状性/任何颅内出血。

sections.text: 患者中位73岁，45.9%男性。尿激酶组90天无残疾生存的校正风险比为1.49（95%CI 1.08–2.06，P=0.01），逆概率加权分析为1.47（1.04–2.09，P=0.03）。两组90天死亡、症状性颅内出血及48小时内任何颅内出血均未发现统计学显著差异。

sections.text: 这是随机试验中的病因亚组二次分析，不是所有卒中患者均适用的结论。安全终点未达显著差异不等于证实无额外风险；摘要未列绝对获益和各安全事件数，需回原文核对亚组预设性、交互作用及多重比较。

42925507.sourceTitle: Development of a biomimetic manganese dioxide nanoreactor delivery system: Combination of biomimetic platelet/M2 microglia hybrid membrane with Astragaloside IV for the treatment of ischemic stroke.
42925507.sourceAbstract: Conventional nanotherapeutics suffer from rapid immune clearance and insufficient accumulation in ischemic lesions. To overcome these bottlenecks, a stimuli-responsive biomimetic immunomodulatory delivery system was engineered by fusing platelet and M2 microglial membranes onto hollow mesoporous manganese dioxide nanoparticles loaded with the neuroprotective drug Astragaloside IV. The results show that this integrated nanoplatform fully leverages the synergistic properties of its biomimetic shell. Tracing the nanoparticles with the fluorescent dye Did revealed that the integrated nanoplatform exhibited more pronounced fluorescent enrichment in ischemic brain tissue; both in vivo and ex vivo imaging supported its specific homing ability. In a mouse model of middle cerebral artery occlusion and reperfusion, the platform significantly reduced the extent of cerebral infarction, alleviated neuronal damage caused by ischemia-reperfusion, and improved neurovascular integrity and neurological function. Furthermore, the platform mitigated oxidative stress in ischemic brain tissue, curtailed the inflammatory response, and facilitated a transition in microglial phenotype toward an anti-inflammatory and reparative state. Bioinformatics results indicate that this platform significantly alters gene expression profiles following cerebral ischemia-reperfusion. Differential expression and functional enrichment analyses further point to biological processes related to inflammation and immune regulation. These findings demonstrate that this biomimetic targeted nanoplatform integrates biomimetic targeting, reactive oxygen species scavenging, and immune modulation capabilities, thereby providing a new therapeutic platform technology for the precise delivery of therapeutic agents and the remodeling of the pathological microenvironment in ischemic stroke.

sections.text: 以负载黄芪甲苷Ⅳ的空心介孔二氧化锰为核心，融合两类细胞膜形成刺激响应体系。通过DiD荧光示踪、体内外成像及小鼠大脑中动脉闭塞/再灌注实验，评价靶向、神经血管损伤、氧化应激、炎症和基因表达。

sections.heading: 主要结果

42925508.sourceTitle: Oleanolic acid-hesperetin co-assembled nanoparticles alleviate neurological injury after ischemic stroke via the PI3K/AKT/GSK-3β axis.
42925508.sourceAbstract: Ischemic stroke remains a leading cause of death and long-term disability, while the current clinically applicable adjunctive neuroprotective strategies face substantial limitations. Oleanolic acid and hesperetin exhibit synergistic antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-apoptotic activities; however, their poor aqueous solubility and limited bioavailability remain major limitations to their therapeutic development. Oleanolic acid and hesperetin were formulated as co-assembled nanoparticles using an emulsion-solvent evaporation method. A 5:2 mass ratio of oleanolic acid to hesperetin produced primarily spherical nanoparticles with a mean hydrodynamic diameter of approximately 282.6 nm, a polydispersity index of 0.197, and a zeta potential of -12.2 mV. Oleanolic acid-hesperetin nanoparticles displayed minimal hemolysis (0.199%) while maintaining a stable hydrodynamic diameter during 30 days of storage. Spectroscopic analyses and a 50 ns molecular dynamics simulation promoted co-assembly via multiple noncovalent-driven interactions. Oleanolic acid-hesperetin nanoparticles effectively reduced oxygen-glucose deprivation/reperfusion-induced viability loss and apoptosis in HT22 cells. In transient middle cerebral artery occlusion mice, Cy5.5-associated fluorescence was observed in brain tissue, whereas oleanolic acid-hesperetin nanoparticle treatment reduced infarct volume and ipsilesional brain water content, preserved neurons, resulting in improved sensorimotor and spatial cognitive outcomes through day 28. Treatment promoted PI3K and AKT phosphorylation, elevated inhibitory phosphorylation of glycogen synthase kinase 3β at Ser9 and BCL-2 expression, and reduced BAX expression. These findings suggest that oleanolic acid-hesperetin co-assembly offers a promising preclinical formulation approach for multifactorial neuroprotection after ischemic stroke and supports further pharmacokinetic, safety, and pathway-causality studies.

sections.text: 利用齐墩果酸与橙皮素共组装改善水溶性与利用度，探索其对缺血性卒中多环节神经保护的作用及PI3K/AKT/GSK-3β相关机制。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 乳化-溶剂蒸发制备质量比5:2的纳米粒，进行理化、溶血、储存与50 ns分子动力学分析。以HT22氧糖剥夺/复氧及小鼠短暂大脑中动脉闭塞模型，观察细胞凋亡、梗死、脑水含量、运动及空间认知至第28天。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 粒径约282.6 nm，PDI 0.197，ζ电位−12.2 mV；溶血率0.199%，30天储存粒径稳定。处理减轻细胞活性损失和凋亡，小鼠梗死体积及同侧脑水含量降低，神经元保留与功能表现改善。PI3K和AKT磷酸化、GSK-3β Ser9抑制性磷酸化及BCL-2升高，BAX降低。

sections.heading: 结论与局限

42925521.sourceTitle: Mechanisms of Spns2 in regulating neuroinflammatory activation of microglia after cerebral ischemia in rats.
42925521.sourceAbstract: Microglia, the resident innate immune cells of the brain, maintain central nervous system homeostasis but can also mediate inflammatory injury after ischemic stroke. Following ischemia, microglia can adopt pro-inflammatory M1- or reparative M2-like state; thus, regulating the balance between these phenotypes may be therapeutically relevant. Sphingosine-1-phosphate signaling regulates immune responses, angiogenesis, and endothelial barrier integrity. Enhanced sphingosine-1-phosphate signaling in activated microglia after ischemic injury may amplify inflammatory cascades. However, strategies targeting sphingosine-1-phosphate signaling are constrained by the heterogeneous expression of sphingosine-1-phosphate receptors. Spinster homolog 2 (Spns2), a sphingosine-1-phosphate exporter, may provide an alternative target, although its role in ischemic stroke remains unclear. To investigate the role of Spns2 in post-ischemic neuroinflammation, middle cerebral artery occlusion/reperfusion was induced in Spns2-deficient (Spns2-/-) and wild-type rats. BV2 microglial cells exposed to oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation were used as an in vitro model. Spns2 mRNA expression in the peri-infarct penumbra increased after middle cerebral artery occlusion/reperfusion and peaked at 24 hours. Compared with wild-type rats, Spns2-/- rats showed lower neurological deficit scores, improved motor performance, and smaller infarct volumes. In the peri-infarct penumbra, Spns2 deficiency was associated with decreased expression of pro-inflammatory markers, increased expression of anti-inflammatory markers, and attenuated microglia-associated NOD-like receptor pyrin domain-containing protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome signaling. In BV2 cells, Spns2 knockdown produced similar changes in inflammatory-marker expression and reduced oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation-induced NLRP3 inflammasome-associated signaling and oxidative stress. Spns2 knockdown reduced extracellular sphingosine-1-phosphate levels in BV2-cell culture supernatants, whereas exogenous sphingosine-1-phosphate supplementation increased the expression of inflammasome-associated inflammatory mediators in Spns2-knockdown BV2 cells. RNA sequencing identified Itga5 upregulation in Spns2-/- rats and showed that differentially expressed genes between Spns2-/- and wild-type rats were enriched in the phosphoinositide 3-kinase/protein kinase B (Akt) signaling pathway. Increased Akt phosphorylation in Spns2-/- rats was further confirmed by western blotting. These findings indicate that Spns2 deficiency limits sphingosine-1-phosphate export and attenuates microglia-associated neuroinflammation after ischemic stroke. Itga5 upregulation and increased Akt phosphorylation may be associated with this neuroprotective effect. Collectively, our results provide a basis for further investigation of the Spns2-sphingosine-1-phosphate axis in ischemic stroke.

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: Spns2在半暗带缺血后上调、24小时达峰。缺失大鼠神经缺损和梗死较轻、运动较好，促炎标志及小胶质细胞相关NLRP3信号下降。细胞敲低后胞外S1P及氧化应激降低，补充S1P使炎症小体相关介质增加。RNA测序发现Itga5上调与PI3K/Akt通路富集，Akt磷酸化增加。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 遗传缺失与短期药物抑制并不等同，S1P也参与血管及免疫稳态。Itga5与Akt变化目前是相关机制线索，不应写成全部已证实的必要通路；摘要未给出样本量及效应值，临床安全性和可靶向性仍需研究。

42926084.sourceTitle: Neuroprotective effect by splenic hypothermia in ischemic stroke.
42926084.sourceAbstract:
OBJECTIVE: To investigate whether spleen-targeted remote administration of hypothermia (RAH) modulates splenic neutrophil release, attenuates neutrophil-driven cerebral inflammation, and preserves BBB integrity at early reperfusion after stroke.

METHODS: Adult male Sprague-Dawley rats underwent 2-h middle cerebral artery occlusion followed by 6-, 24- and 48- h of reperfusion. RAH was applied to the splenic region via surface cooling, with 1-min cycles administered at 5-min intervals. Neurological deficits, infarct volume, neutrophil infiltration, cytokine expression, BBB integrity, and apoptosis were assessed using neurobehavioral scoring, TTC staining, Western blotting, rt-PCR, immunofluorescence, ELISA, and TUNEL, respectively.

RESULTS: RAH rapidly reduced splenic temperature from 370 to 28 °C without altering body or brain temperatures. At 6 h reperfusion, splenic neutrophil release was suppressed and brain neutrophil infiltration decreased. RAH reduced early elevations of TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6. At 24 h, anti-inflammatory effects persisted and BBB integrity was preserved, restoring tight-junction and matrix proteins and suppressing BBB-damaging mediators. Compared to non-RAH stroked rats, RAH reduced apoptosis, body weight loss (9.1 ± 2.8 vs. 19.7 ± 7.2 g, p < 0.05), infarct volume (33.9 ± 4.1% vs. 53.6 ± 1.9%, p < 0.05), cerebral edema (11.2 ± 0.9% vs. 16.3 ± 1.3%, p < 0.05) and Evans blue extravasation (4.8 ± 0.2 vs. 9.8 ± 0.2 mg/g, p < 0.05), and improved neurological outcomes. RAH attenuated stroke-induced spleen weight loss and contraction, consistent with reduced splenic neutrophil mobilization.

CONCLUSIONS: RAH induces neuroprotection after ischemic stroke by suppressing splenic neutrophil activation and mobilization, thus attenuating peripheral-to-central inflammatory trafficking and preserving BBB integrity. These findings highlight spleen-targeted cooling may represent a promising early intervention to ischemic stroke.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 研究仅冷却脾区是否能够抑制脾中性粒细胞动员，减少卒中早期外周至脑的炎症迁移并维持血脑屏障。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 成年雄性SD大鼠大脑中动脉闭塞2小时，随后再灌注6、24或48小时。脾区表面间歇冷却，每5分钟安排1分钟冷却，检测神经功能、梗死、炎症、屏障及凋亡。摘要起始脾温写为“370”，明显异常，不能据此确定原始温度，应回原文核对。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 脾温降至28°C而体温、脑温未改变；6小时脾中性粒细胞释放及脑浸润减少，24小时抗炎和屏障保护仍存在。冷却组比未冷却卒中组体重下降9.1±2.8比19.7±7.2 g，梗死体积33.9±4.1%比53.6±1.9%，脑水肿11.2±0.9%比16.3±1.3%，Evans蓝外渗4.8±0.2比9.8±0.2 mg/g，均报告P<0.05。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 这是短期雄性大鼠实验，并非患者局部低温治疗证据。异常起始温度已标出，不能默默修正后当作可靠原始数据；还需核对冷却参数、时间窗、对照及长远安全性，炎症抑制关联不能穷尽全部作用机制。

42928039.sourceTitle: Trends in incident hemodialysis access and mortality in China: results from China Renal Data System 2000-2024.
42928039.sourceAbstract:
BACKGROUNDS: Large‑scale multicenter data on vascular access among Chinese incident hemodialysis (HD) patients are limited. We explored temporal trends of initial vascular access and its relationship with all‑cause mortality.

METHODS: This retrospective cohort study was conducted using the China Renal Data System, enrolling incident HD patients from January 2000 to April 2024. Vascular access trends and distribution at HD initiation were analyzed.

RESULTS: 16,717 patients were enrolled (mean age 55.62 ± 10.93 years; 61.54% male; mean follow‑up 64.41 months). At HD initiation, 29.17% of patients used arteriovenous fistula/graft (AVF/AVG), while 70.83% used central venous catheter (CVC), comprising 60.78% with a maturing AVF/AVG and 10.06% with CVC alone. AVF/AVG use increased from 26.24% in 2015 to 35.77% in 2024, while CVC-only use decreased from 16.16% to 8.27%. Mortality rates per 100 person-years were 4.15 (95% confidence interval [CI] 3.93 - 4.38), 7.24 (95% CI 7.00 - 7.49), and 15.08 (95% CI 14.07 - 16.15) in the AVF/AVG, CVC with maturing AVF/AVG, and CVC-only groups, respectively. In the adjusted Cox model, patients using CVC with a maturing AVF/AVG or CVC alone exhibited 36% and 91% higher all-cause mortality risks, respectively, compared with those using AVF/AVG.

CONCLUSIONS: Over the 25-year period, initial vascular access among Chinese incident HD patients gradually shifted from CVC to AVF/AVG, reflecting ongoing and considerable improvements in vascular access practice in China. CVC use at HD initiation was associated with higher all-cause mortality compared with AVF/AVG. These findings support early AVF/AVG creation in end-stage kidney disease patients to avoid CVC use at HD initiation.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 描绘中国新开始血液透析患者初始血管通路在2000—2024年间的变化，比较不同初始通路与全因死亡的关系。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 基于中国肾脏病数据系统的多中心回顾性队列，纳入2000年1月至2024年4月开始透析的16717名患者。比较动静脉瘘/移植物（AVF/AVG）、合并正在成熟AVF/AVG的中心静脉导管（CVC），以及仅CVC三组；平均随访64.41个月。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 初始使用AVF/AVG占29.17%，使用CVC占70.83%。AVF/AVG初始使用率从2015年的26.24%升至2024年的35.77%，仅CVC比例从16.16%降至8.27%。三组每100人年死亡率分别为4.15、7.24和15.08。校正模型中，后两组相对AVF/AVG组的全因死亡风险分别高36%和91%。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 研究显示初始透析通路逐步由CVC转向AVF/AVG，且CVC使用与较高死亡风险相关。但不同通路患者的疾病状态、准备程度等可能存在差异；这里不能将观察性关联直接视为通路选择的因果效果。

42933919.sourceTitle: Two-Year Outcomes of the Prospective THRILLER Registry on Popliteal and Infrapopliteal Endovascular Interventions for CLTI.
42933919.sourceAbstract:
BACKGROUND: Over 70% of patients with chronic limb-threatening ischemia (CLTI) present with below-the-knee disease, and there is a growing trend towards endovascular revascularization.

OBJECTIVES: The Dutch Chronic Lower Limb-Threatening Ischemia Registry (THRILLER) aimed to provide real-world data on outcomes after popliteal and infrapopliteal endovascular revascularization to guide revascularization strategies.

METHODS: This prospective multicenter registry included consecutive CLTI patients undergoing popliteal or infrapopliteal endovascular revascularization in seven Dutch hospitals. Primary outcomes were limb salvage and amputation-free survival (AFS) at 24 months, estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method.

RESULTS: Between February 2021 and December 2023, a total of 1,119 interventions in 1,060 limbs (938 patients) were included, treating 551 popliteal, 1,352 tibial, and 239 pedal lesions. The median follow-up was 43.6 months (Q1-Q3: 35.5-52.7 months). Overall, 78.4% (831/1,060) of the limbs were Rutherford 5 and 8.1% (86/1,060) were Rutherford 6; 41.3% (382/926) were WIfI (Wound, Ischemia, and foot Infection) stage 4. Technical success was achieved in 92.3% (1,033/1,119). Limb salvage and AFS decreased significantly after technical failure and with increasing WIfI stage and Rutherford category. Compared to Rutherford 5, Rutherford 6 limbs had significantly worse limb salvage (HR: 3.07; 95% CI: 1.89-4.99; P < 0.001) and AFS (HR: 2.07; 95% CI: 1.50-2.86; P < 0.001). For AFS, the excess risk of Rutherford 6 was greatest in the first 3 months (HR: 14.13; 95% CI: 4.94-40.38 vs Rutherford 4; P < 0.001).

CONCLUSIONS: Endovascular revascularization for popliteal and infrapopliteal disease in patients with CLTI is safe and effective in preventing limb loss and mortality at 2 years, although patients with Rutherford 6 limbs face significantly worse outcomes, particularly in the first 3 months.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 通过THRILLER真实世界登记，了解CLTI患者接受腘动脉及膝下动脉腔内血运重建后的保肢和无截肢生存情况，并识别结局较差的人群。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 荷兰7家医院开展前瞻性多中心登记，连续纳入2021年2月至2023年12月接受相关治疗的患者。共938名患者、1060条肢体和1119次介入；主要观察24个月保肢和无截肢生存（AFS）。人群以Rutherford 5级为主，占78.4%；Rutherford 6级占8.1%，可评估者中WIfI 4期占41.3%。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 介入技术成功率为92.3%，中位随访43.6个月。技术失败、WIfI分期升高及Rutherford分级升高均伴随更差结局。相较Rutherford 5级，6级肢体的保肢相关风险比为3.07（95%CI 1.89—4.99），AFS相关风险比为2.07（1.50—2.86）；6级患者AFS的额外风险在最初3个月尤其突出。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 作者认为该策略在登记人群中取得了有意义的两年结局，但严重组织缺损患者仍是高危群体。该研究并非将腔内治疗随机对照于其他重建方法的试验；解读时应同时关注基线肢体严重程度、技术成功情况和不同分期的分层结果。

42935188.sourceTitle: Cross-elbow stent placement for refractory arteriovenous fistula stenosis and chronic total occlusion in hemodialysis patients: a single-center retrospective cohort of 42 cases.
42935188.sourceAbstract: Cross-elbow stent placement in hemodialysis arteriovenous fistulas (AVFs) has been avoided due to risks of fracture, kinking, deformation, migration, and infection. However, elbow lesions may be refractory to angioplasty and progress to chronic total occlusion (CTO). We evaluated the safety, feasibility, and patency of cross-elbow stenting for AVF salvage. Consecutive adult hemodialysis patients who received cross-elbow stents for clinically significant AVF stenosis or CTO (September 2021 - March 2026) at a single center were retrospectively analyzed. Primary outcomes were target lesion primary patency (TLPP), access circuit primary patency (ACPP), access circuit secondary patency, and access circuit assisted primary patency, estimated by Kaplan-Meier. Technical and clinical success and complications were recorded. Forty-two patients were included; 45.2% had CTO and 57.1% had prior PTA. Eluvia-based stents were used in 83.3%. Technical and clinical success were both 100%. Mean access flow increased from 407 ± 267 to 839 ± 188 mL/min. TLPP at 3, 6, 12, and 24 months was 90.1%, 84.4%, 76.9%, and 76.9%, respectively. No stent fracture, migration, kinking, or infection occurred. Cross-elbow stenting was technically feasible and provided favorable short- to mid-term patency without device-related complications, supporting its use as a salvage option for selected refractory AVF lesions and CTOs.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 评价跨肘关节支架用于难治性血液透析动静脉内瘘狭窄或慢性完全闭塞时的可行性、安全性与通畅率。传统上此部位支架存在断裂、折曲、变形、移位及感染顾虑。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 单中心回顾性纳入2021年9月至2026年3月接受跨肘支架的42例成人透析患者。主要观察靶病变一期通畅、通路一期/二期通畅和辅助一期通畅，按Kaplan–Meier估计，同时记录技术、临床成功与并发症。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 45.2%存在慢性完全闭塞，57.1%曾行球囊扩张，83.3%使用以Eluvia为主的支架。技术和临床成功率均为100%；平均通路流量由407±267增至839±188 mL/min。3、6、12、24个月靶病变一期通畅率依次为90.1%、84.4%、76.9%、76.9%。随访期间未记录支架断裂、移位、折曲或感染。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 结果支持其作为经过选择的难治性内瘘病变的挽救方案，但仅42例、单中心、无随机对照，不能据此认定常规跨肘支架没有风险。摘要未完整列出其他各项通畅终点和长期随访人数，需结合原文及器械适用范围判断。

42949816.sourceTitle: Electrodeposited Heterostructured Fe-Zn Alloy Microtubes for Vascular Stents: Achieving Enhanced Strength, Ductility, and Uniform Degradation.
42949816.sourceAbstract: To synergistically enhance the strength-ductility trade‑off and achieve uniform degradation in Fe-Zn alloys, heterostructured alloy microtubes were fabricated via layer‑by‑layer electrodeposition on a rotating soluble aluminum mandrel. Microstructural characterization revealed a columnar‑layered architecture with coherent interfacial bonding after annealing, free of delamination or defects. The heterostructured sample containing ten alternating soft layers (FZ10) exhibited an ultimate tensile strength of approximately 605 MPa and an elongation of about 17.3%, both superior to those of the single-layer alloy. The loading-unloading-reloading (LUR) experiments demonstrated pronounced hetero-deformation induced (HDI) strengthening and HDI strain-hardening effects, indicating the critical role of interfacial constraints in deformation coordination. Electrochemical and simulated body fluid (SBF) immersion tests showed that the heterostructure promoted faster and more uniform corrosion, with an average degradation rate of approximately 0.135 mm·y- 1 after 56 days, suppressing localized pitting. XPS and FTIR analyses identified the corrosion products as Fe/Zn oxides and Ca-P compounds, forming a bilayer degradation film with a dense inner layer and a loose outer layer. Additionally, heterostructured Fe-Zn alloy microtubes exhibited favorable cytocompatibility. These heterostructured microtubes integrate high strength, ductility, and controlled and uniform degradability, making them promising candidates for further development as biodegradable vascular stent materials.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 制备用于可降解血管支架的铁锌合金微管，尝试同时改善强度、延展性和降解均匀性，避免单纯强化导致脆化或局部点蚀。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 在旋转可溶铝芯轴上逐层电沉积，再退火形成柱状-层状异质结构。进行微结构、拉伸、加载–卸载–再加载、电化学、模拟体液浸泡、XPS/FTIR及细胞相容性测试。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 含10层交替软层的FZ10抗拉强度约605 MPa、伸长率约17.3%，均优于单层合金。力学试验支持异质变形诱导强化及加工硬化。56天后平均降解速率约0.135 mm/年，腐蚀更快且更均匀、局部点蚀受到抑制；降解产物含Fe/Zn氧化物与钙磷化合物，形成致密内层/疏松外层膜，细胞相容性较好。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 这是材料微管与体外评价，不是已完成的血管支架动物或人体试验。拉伸指标和模拟体液腐蚀不能替代径向支撑、疲劳、血液相容、血栓、内皮化及体内降解评价；“更快降解”是否适合特定血管需与支撑窗口匹配。

42951329.sourceTitle: Development of a machine learning model to predict venous thromboembolism risk in women using combined oral contraceptives.
42951329.sourceAbstract:
OBJECTIVE: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) is a major cause of morbidity and mortality, with combined oral contraceptives (COCPs) being a modifiable risk factor. Existing clinical tools have limited ability to capture complex predictor interactions. This study aimed to develop and evaluate machine learning (ML) models to predict VTE risk among COCP users.

METHODS: This study was conducted using data from the Saudi Real-World Evidence Network (2016–2023). The primary outcome was the first VTE event within 2 years of COCP initiation. Following data partitioning, feature selection was performed on the training set. Elastic-net logistic regression, random forest (RF), extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost), one-class support vector machine and Isolation-Forest were trained on original and resampled datasets. Performance was evaluated using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and F1 score.

RESULTS: The cohort included 24 518 treatment episodes (n=17 512, VTE events=52). After handling class imbalance, RF and XGBoost were the best-performing models (F1: 84.3% and 81.6%; AUROC: 59.6% and 69.2%, respectively), compared with other models (F1: 2.6%–55.3%, AUROC: 54.2%–68.4%). Key predictors included age, glucocorticoid use and rheumatic, renal and thyroid diseases.

DISCUSSION: ML shows potential for VTE risk detection despite low event rate and class imbalance. However, findings suggest synthetic sample overfitting, and external validation is warranted before clinical deployment. Identified predictors reinforce the role of metabolic and inflammatory factors in VTE susceptibility among COCP users.

CONCLUSION: ML models, particularly XGBoost and RF, demonstrated moderate predictive ability for VTE among COCP users, supporting their use in individualised risk assessments, though external validation is warranted.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 开发并评估机器学习模型，预测使用复方口服避孕药女性在开始用药后2年内首次发生VTE的风险。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 使用沙特真实世界证据网络2016—2023年数据，共24518次治疗记录、17512名患者和52例VTE事件。比较弹性网络回归、随机森林、XGBoost、单类支持向量机及孤立森林，在原始和重采样数据上训练，评估AUROC与F1分数。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 处理类别不平衡后，随机森林和XGBoost的F1分数分别为84.3%和81.6%，但AUROC分别仅为59.6%和69.2%。重要预测因素包括年龄、糖皮质激素使用以及风湿、肾脏和甲状腺疾病。结果表明，较高F1分数并不意味着模型的总体区分能力已达到很高水平。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: VTE事件较少且类别高度不平衡，摘要提示合成样本过拟合风险。模型尚需外部验证，不能仅据内部性能指标直接用于临床风险决策；需要特别检查数据重采样、验证划分和校准情况。

42953917.sourceTitle: Engineering a Translational Human Thrombus Platform to Evaluate Clinical Therapies in Ischemic Stroke.
42953917.sourceAbstract:
BACKGROUND: Recanalization failure after ischemic stroke remains a major clinical challenge, partly because cerebral thrombi display marked spatial heterogeneity that is poorly reproduced by experimental models. Here, we engineered a translational human blood-based thrombus platform that recapitulates key histological features of patient-derived stroke clots.

METHODS: Under controlled conditions, the platform generated reproducible thrombi with pronounced interthrombus and intrathrombus heterogeneity, including alternating red blood cell-rich and platelet-rich territories. Multiscale structural and biochemical analyses confirmed the successful replication of the clinical biphasic organization associated with resistance to rtPA (recombinant tissue-type plasminogen activator): a compact outer fibrin shell containing focal accumulations of plasminogen activator inhibitor-1, and a dense inner core further stabilized by neutrophil extracellular traps.

RESULTS: Functional thrombolysis assays demonstrated that this architecture directly dictates lytic susceptibility. Specifically, artificially breaching the outer fibrin shell (halved thrombi) significantly accelerated early rtPA-mediated lysis, proving its role as an effective physical barrier. Furthermore, lytic response was inherently linked to clot composition: platelet-rich thrombi with dense plasminogen activator inhibitor-1 and neutrophil extracellular trap networks exhibited profound resistance to standard rtPA compared with red blood cell-rich clots. Supporting the platform's translational relevance, this structural resistance was successfully overcome by clinically relevant strategies, including tenecteplase and adjunctive DNAse, consistent with observations from human stroke cohorts.

CONCLUSIONS: By accurately reproducing the spatial organization and differential thrombolytic responses of human cerebral thrombi, this translational framework provides a robust preclinical tool to dissect lytic resistance and evaluate next-generation precision reperfusion therapies. Furthermore, developing robust ex vivo human platforms is increasingly critical to align with the replacement, reduction, refinement ethical guidelines for animal research.

sections.text: 建立更接近真实卒中血栓空间异质性的体外人血血栓平台，用于解释溶栓抵抗并评价再灌注策略。

sections.text: 在可控条件下生成人血来源血栓，重现红细胞富集区与血小板富集区交替结构。利用多尺度结构、生化检测与功能性溶栓试验，研究外层纤维蛋白壳、PAI-1及中性粒细胞胞外诱捕网（NETs）的作用，并测试替奈普酶及辅助DNA酶。

42955876.sourceTitle: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics reveal mesenchymal stem cell-associated neuroimmune and neuronal signaling patterns after ischemic stroke.
42955876.sourceAbstract: Ischemic stroke induces coordinated yet spatially heterogeneous neuroimmune and neuronal responses that shape secondary injury and tissue remodeling. However, how intranasal mesenchymal stem cell administration is associated with these cell type-specific responses remains incompletely understood. Here, we integrated single-cell RNA sequencing of the ipsilateral cerebrum on days 1, 7, and 14 after middle cerebral artery occlusion/reperfusion with spatial transcriptomic profiling on day 7. A total of 55,520 high-quality single-cell transcriptomes were obtained from control, middle cerebral artery occlusion/reperfusion, and mesenchymal stem cell-treated samples. In this exploratory dataset, the middle cerebral artery occlusion/reperfusion samples showed relatively greater representation of inflammatory and antigen-presenting microglial states and elevated expression of selected microglial state-associated genes, including Slfn4, Apoe, and Gpnmb. In the corresponding exploratory comparison, the mesenchymal stem cell-treated sample showed relatively greater representation of homeostatic-associated and Lgals3/Spp1-enriched microglial states and lower expression of several inflammatory-associated genes. Spatial mapping further revealed regionally restricted expression of microglial and neuronal markers within the injured tissue. Excitatory neurons displayed preliminary mesenchymal stem cell-associated transcriptional patterns involving mitochondrial transcripts, oxidative phosphorylation, synaptic signaling, calcium-related functions, and apoptosis/autophagy-associated pathways. CellChat analysis computationally predicted relatively high levels of tumor necrosis factor, C-X-C motif chemokine ligand, and complement signaling in the middle cerebral artery occlusion/reperfusion sample, whereas the mesenchymal stem cell-treated sample had relatively high levels of predicted activity of neuregulin, pleiotrophin and selected semaphorin. Together, these integrated datasets provide a hypothesis-generating framework linking microglial state remodeling, neuronal metabolic and synaptic programs, and predicted neuroimmune communication patterns after ischemic stroke. Because each omics condition or time point was represented by one biological sample, all the transcriptomic findings should be considered preliminary and exploratory and should be validated in independently replicated cohorts.

sections.text: 通过单细胞和空间转录组，探索脑缺血后鼻内给予间充质干细胞与小胶质细胞状态、神经元代谢及细胞间信号模式的关系。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 联合大脑中动脉闭塞/再灌注后第1、7、14天同侧大脑单细胞RNA测序及第7天空间组学，共获得55520个高质量单细胞转录组，并用CellChat预测通讯。关键限制是每个组学条件或时间点只有1个生物学样本。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 缺血样本中炎症和抗原呈递相关小胶质状态较多，Slfn4、Apoe、Gpnmb等表达升高；干细胞处理样本中稳态相关及Lgals3/Spp1富集状态相对增多，部分炎症基因降低。神经元出现线粒体、氧化磷酸化、突触、钙及凋亡/自噬相关转录模式变化。计算预测从TNF、趋化因子及补体偏高，转向neuregulin、pleiotrophin及部分semaphorin相关信号。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 所有组学结果都是探索性、假设生成性的；大量细胞数不能弥补缺乏生物学重复。CellChat预测不等于实际测得的电活动、细胞通讯或因果机制，也不能据此认定干细胞治疗有效；需要独立重复队列和功能验证。

42959271.sourceTitle: Panax notoginseng-Derived Carbon Quantum Dots as a Novel Administration Strategy for Cerebral Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury Therapy.
42959271.sourceAbstract: The present study aimed to synthesize Panax notoginseng-derived carbon quantum dots (PN-CDs) and explore their role in cerebral ischemia-reperfusion injury (CIRI). PN-CDs were synthesized by the hydrothermal method, and characterization and biocompatibility were assessed. Next, CIRI models were established using SH-SY5Y cells, primary neurons were treated with oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation (OGD/R), and rats were subjected to middle cerebral artery occlusion/reperfusion (MCAO/R). After PN-CDs treatment, inflammation, apoptosis, and oxidative stress were detected in neuronal cells and rats using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, quantitative reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction, flow cytometry, Western blot, and 2',7'-dichlorodihydrofluorescein diacetate probe. Meanwhile, 2,3,5-triphenyltetrazolium chloride, terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase dUTP nick end labeling, Nissl, and hematoxylin and eosin staining were employed to measure the pathological damage of rats. Additionally, CIRI rats were administered with PN-CDs, Panax notoginseng saponins (PNS), Panax notoginseng (PN), or edaravone to investigate whether PN-CDs had the best effect. The findings revealed that PN-CDs exhibited favorable biocompatibility and crossed the blood-brain barrier. In vitro, PN-CD treatment inhibited oxidative stress, apoptosis, and inflammation, as evidenced by the decrease of interleukin-1β (IL-1β), IL-6, Bax, C-caspase-3, tumor necrosis factor-α, malondialdehyde, and reactive oxygen species and the increase of superoxide dismutase, Bcl-2, and glutathione. In CIRI rats, PN-CDs improved pathological damage and suppressed inflammation, apoptosis, and oxidative stress. The therapeutic effect of PN-CDs on CIRI was distinctly better than that of PNS and PN, and comparable to that of the first-line drug edaravone. In short, PN-CDs, a novel and efficient administration strategy, alleviates CIRI by inhibiting apoptosis, oxidative stress, and inflammation.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 制备三七来源碳量子点（PN-CDs），探索这种递送策略对脑缺血再灌注损伤的作用，并与三七、三七皂苷及依达拉奉作前临床比较。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 水热法合成并表征PN-CDs，评估生物相容性。采用SH-SY5Y细胞、原代神经元氧糖剥夺/复氧及大鼠大脑中动脉闭塞/再灌注模型，检测炎症、氧化应激、凋亡和组织病理损伤。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 摘要报告PN-CDs具有较好相容性且可穿过血脑屏障。细胞中IL-1β、IL-6、TNF-α、Bax、裂解caspase-3、丙二醛及活性氧下降，SOD、Bcl-2及谷胱甘肽升高；大鼠组织损伤及炎症、凋亡、氧化应激减轻。在该动物模型中作用优于三七及其皂苷，作者报告与依达拉奉相当。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 摘要没有给出样本量、剂量、关键效应值或等效界限，因此“与依达拉奉相当”不能被理解为临床等效性已获证明。需进一步核对制备一致性、长期毒性和体内分布；这是细胞和大鼠实验，不是患者疗效证据。

42962796.sourceTitle: Remote ischemic preconditioning protects against cerebral ischemia/reperfusion injury through lactate-dependent AMPK/ULK1 signaling and autophagy.
42962796.sourceAbstract: Cerebral ischemia-reperfusion (I/R) injury is a major contributor to ischemic cerebral damage and poor functional outcomes following ischemic stroke, and effective neuroprotective strategies remain limited. Remote ischemic preconditioning (RIPC) has emerged as a promising, noninvasive approach; however, its underlying mechanisms are incompletely understood. Here, we investigated whether lactate serves as a key metabolic mediator linking RIPC to neuroprotection through regulation of autophagy. Using an oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation (OGD/R) model in PC12 cells and a middle cerebral artery occlusion (MCAO) model in rats, we demonstrate that I/R impairs autophagic flux, as evidenced by p62 accumulation and reduced LC3-II and Beclin-1 expression, leading to increased cellular apoptosis and injury. Lactate supplementation restored autophagic flux, enhanced cell viability, and suppressed apoptosis under OGD/R conditions. Mechanistically, lactate activated the AMPK/ULK1 signaling pathway, whereas pharmacological inhibition of AMPK or ULK1 attenuated lactate-induced autophagy and cytoprotection. In vivo, RIPC elevated plasma and cerebral lactate levels, activated AMPK/ULK1 signaling, promoted autophagy, reduced infarct volume, and improved acute neurological outcomes. Notably, blockade of lactate transport or inhibition of AMPK/ULK1 signaling attenuated these protective effects. Collectively, our findings suggest that lactate serves as an important mediator of RIPC-induced neuroprotection and reveal a novel lactate-AMPK/ULK1-autophagy axis that mitigates cerebral I/R injury. These results provide mechanistic insight into RIPC and suggest potential therapeutic targets for ischemic stroke.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 探索远隔缺血预适应（RIPC）是否通过乳酸这一代谢介质，调节AMPK/ULK1信号与自噬，从而减轻脑缺血再灌注损伤。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 采用PC12细胞氧糖剥夺/复氧模型及大鼠大脑中动脉闭塞模型。通过补充乳酸、阻断乳酸转运、药理抑制AMPK或ULK1，检测细胞活性、凋亡、自噬相关指标、脑梗死体积与急性神经结局。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 缺血再灌注伴p62累积及LC3-II、Beclin-1降低，提示自噬通量受损。乳酸补充恢复相关通量并减轻细胞凋亡，AMPK或ULK1抑制削弱这种效应。在大鼠中，RIPC提高血浆和脑乳酸，激活AMPK/ULK1、促进自噬，减少梗死并改善急性神经表现；阻断乳酸转运或该信号轴后保护效应减弱。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 这是细胞与大鼠机制研究，摘要未报告样本量和效应大小。药理阻断支持通路参与，但不能单独证明其为唯一机制；短期动物获益不能外推为患者补充乳酸或直接激活自噬的治疗建议。该文并非氢气干预试验。

42962862.sourceTitle: Index Below-Knee Endovascular Intervention for Intermittent Claudication Is Associated with Increased Amputation Risk.
42962862.sourceAbstract:
INTRODUCTION: Guidelines advise against infrapopliteal peripheral vascular intervention (PVI) for intermittent claudication (IC) due to potential harm with unclear benefit. We hypothesized that below-knee intervention at index PVI for IC confers higher future amputation risk than above-knee-only treatment.

METHODS: From the VQI PVI registry (2015-2025), we identified elective, initial PVIs for IC and compared those patients undergoing above-knee-only treatment (AK) to those having any below-knee intervention (BK). Using our previously described methodology, long-term amputation data were obtained by linking the PVI and amputation registries via unique patient identifiers. Demographic and procedural data were analyzed descriptively. Kaplan-Meier Analysis estimated risk of major and any (major+minor) amputation, with independent predictors of amputation identified by multivariable Firth logistic regression.

RESULTS: Among 92,899 treated limbs (81,338 AK; 11,561 BK), BK patients had increased rates of diabetes (54% vs. 41%), CHF (18% vs. 13%), and ESRD/dialysis (4.7% vs. 1.7%, p<0.001). BK patients were more likely to be Black (21% vs. 13%, p<0.001), Hispanic (8.8% vs. 4.3%, p<0.001), and Asian (1.5% vs. 1.0%, p<0.001). Smoking history predominated in AK (89% vs. 67%, p<0.001). 16,086 limbs required repeat PVI, 13,831 (17%) in the AK group vs. 2,255 (20%) in the BK group (p<0.001). At reintervention, BK patients were more likely to have progressed to CLTI (41% vs. 25%; p<0.001) and undergo ≥2 repeat interventions (32% vs. 27%; p<0.001). Initial below-knee intervention was associated with greater ipsilateral major (OR 2.39;1.70-3.35) and any (OR 2.36;1.75-3.18) amputation. Kaplan-Meier showed increased major [1-year (0.3% vs 0.1%);5-years (0.4% vs 0.1%)] and any amputation risk [1-year (0.5% vs 0.1%); 5-years (0.7% vs 0.2%).

CONCLUSIONS: Index below-knee intervention for IC portends greater risk of progression to CLTI, repeat PVI, and ipsilateral amputation, highlighting the potentially dangerous treatment trap of infrapopliteal intervention in patients with intermittent claudicants.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 研究间歇性跛行患者首次接受外周血管介入时，加入膝下动脉干预是否与随后更高的截肢、重复干预和进展为CLTI的风险相关。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 使用VQI外周血管介入登记库2015—2025年的择期首次干预记录，将仅膝上治疗与任何膝下干预进行比较，并通过患者标识连接介入和截肢登记数据。用Kaplan–Meier方法估计截肢风险，用多变量Firth回归识别相关因素。共分析92899条肢体，其中膝上治疗81338条、膝下干预11561条。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 膝下组糖尿病、心衰和终末期肾病/透析比例更高；重复介入比例为20%，膝上组为17%。再次介入时，膝下组进展为CLTI的比例为41%，膝上组为25%。首次膝下干预与同侧大截肢（OR 2.39，区间1.70—3.35）及任意截肢（OR 2.36，1.75—3.18）相关。5年任意截肢估计风险为0.7%与0.2%。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 作者提示，对间歇性跛行进行膝下介入可能伴随不利的长期结局。该研究来自登记数据，两组基础疾病严重程度不同；结果属于观察性关联，不能仅凭这些数字断定干预本身造成了截肢，也不能替代个体化的原文与指南评估。

42966855.sourceTitle: Diffusion-weighted imaging reversal after reperfusion therapy in acute ischemic stroke: associations with white matter hyperintensities and cerebral microbleeds.
42966855.sourceAbstract:
BACKGROUND: White matter hyperintensities (WMH) and cerebral microbleeds (CMBs) are common MRI markers of chronic small-vessel brain injury and have been associated with adverse outcomes after ischemic stroke. However, whether these markers influence early ischemic tissue reversibility following reperfusion therapy remains unclear. We therefore investigated their associations with diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) lesion reversal, hemorrhagic complications, and short-term functional outcome after MRI-guided reperfusion therapy.

METHODS: In this retrospective single-center study, consecutive patients with acute ischemic stroke undergoing MRI-guided intravenous thrombolysis, with or without additional mechanical thrombectomy, were included. According to the institutional protocol, follow-up MRI was planned 24 ± 6 h after treatment to assess DWI lesion evolution, WMH volume, and CMBs. DWI reversal was defined as a reduction of ≥ 25% in baseline DWI lesion volume. Multivariable regression analyses were performed to identify predictors of DWI reversal, intracerebral hemorrhage, and functional outcome at hospital discharge.

RESULTS: Among 345 patients (median age 74 years [IQR 63-82], 48.1% female), 45 (13%) additionally underwent mechanical thrombectomy. DWI reversal occurred in 76 patients (22.0%) and was not associated with baseline WMH volume, CMBs, initial infarct volume, treatment modality, or thrombolysis time window. Higher baseline NIHSS and modified Rankin Scale scores were associated with lower odds of DWI reversal, whereas hypercholesterolemia was independently associated with increased odds of DWI reversal. We found no evidence of an association of WMH burden or CMB presence with intracerebral hemorrhage or of an independent association with functional outcome. Fourteen patients (4.1%) developed new CMBs on follow-up MRI.

CONCLUSIONS: We found no evidence of an association between baseline WMH volume or CMB presence and early DWI lesion reversal or hemorrhagic complications following reperfusion therapy in this cohort. These findings provide no evidence that these two chronic MRI markers are major determinants of early infarct tissue reversibility. Larger multicenter studies incorporating comprehensive small-vessel disease phenotyping and long-term follow-up are warranted.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 评估慢性小血管病影像标志——白质高信号（WMH）与脑微出血（CMB）——是否与卒中再灌注后的早期DWI病灶逆转、出血及短期功能结局相关。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入345例MRI引导静脉溶栓患者，其中45例同时机械取栓。计划治疗后24±6小时复查MRI；DWI逆转定义为基线病灶体积减少≥25%，多变量分析逆转、脑出血和出院功能结局。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 患者中位74岁，48.1%女性。76例出现DWI逆转（22.0%），未发现其与基线WMH体积、CMB、初始梗死体积、治疗方式或溶栓时间窗有关。更高基线NIHSS及mRS与逆转概率降低相关，高胆固醇血症与逆转增加相关。未发现WMH负担或CMB与脑出血及独立功能结局的明确关联；14例（4.1%）复查出现新CMB。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 主要结果是未发现关联，不等于证明这些影像特征在所有人群中均无风险、无影响。单中心、选择性MRI治疗路径及短期随访限制解释，需要更大多中心、完整小血管病分型及长期结局验证。

42985190.sourceTitle: Sequential blood-brain barrier-penetrating and microglial-mitochondria-targeting nanosystem for ischemic stroke therapy.
42985190.sourceAbstract: Ischemic stroke (IS) causes severe neurological deficits closely linked to microglial overactivation after ischemia/reperfusion (I/R) injury, a process governed by mitochondrial homeostasis. However, restoring microglial mitochondrial function across the blood-brain barrier (BBB) remains challenging. Here, we report a sequentially targeted nanosystem, M-BPM@TGPB, for I/R injury therapy. It comprises a triphenylphosphonium (TPP)-modified, gadolinium-doped Prussian blue core and a mannose-modified BV2-platelet hybrid membrane shell. This design integrates mannose for BBB penetration, platelet membrane for lesion targeting, BV2 membrane for microglial uptake, and TPP for mitochondrial localization, enabling precise vascular-to-subcellular delivery. In vitro, the nanosystem crossed the BBB, localized to BV2 mitochondria, scavenged reactive oxygen species (ROS), restored mitochondrial function, and inhibited inflammation. In a mouse model of middle cerebral artery occlusion/reperfusion (MCAO/R), the intravenously administered nanosystem accumulated in microglial mitochondria, scavenged mitochondrial ROS (mtROS), restored mitochondrial homeostasis, promoted M1-to-M2 polarization, suppressed neuroinflammation, reduced neuronal apoptosis, and promoted angiogenesis, thereby reducing infarct volume from 36.61% to 10.57% and the modified neurological severity score (mNSS) from 14 to 2.5. It also exhibited favorable biocompatibility and enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) contrast. Critically, rather than broadly scavenging ROS, this strategy specifically restores microglial mitochondrial function, shifting the therapeutic focus from general antioxidant approaches to organelle-specific intervention. This work may offer a promising design paradigm for nanotherapies targeting central nervous system disorders in which mitochondrial dysfunction and neuroinflammation are core pathological drivers.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 设计按“穿越血脑屏障—病灶富集—小胶质细胞摄取—线粒体定位”顺序靶向的纳米系统，以改善卒中后小胶质细胞线粒体失衡和神经炎症。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: M-BPM@TGPB由TPP修饰、钆掺杂普鲁士蓝核心与甘露糖修饰BV2/血小板混合膜构成。体外观察跨屏障、线粒体定位、活性氧与炎症；在小鼠大脑中动脉闭塞/再灌注模型中静脉给药，评估分布、损伤、功能和MRI对比效果。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 摘要报告该系统进入BV2线粒体并改善线粒体功能，抑制炎症。小鼠中线粒体活性氧降低，小胶质细胞标志由促炎向修复方向变化，神经元凋亡减少、血管生成增加；梗死体积由36.61%降至10.57%，改良神经严重度评分由14降至2.5，同时显示MRI增强和较好相容性。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 显著数字来自特定动物模型，不是人体卒中风险或功能改善比例。摘要没有列样本量、方差和全部对照，需核对多级靶向各组分贡献、长期钆/纳米材料安全性；M1/M2是简化表型描述，不代表完整细胞状态。

43002591.sourceTitle: Thrombus stiffness depends on occlusion site and influences thrombectomy outcomes in acute ischemic stroke.
43002591.sourceAbstract:
INTRODUCTION: Only 60% of patients with acute ischemic stroke (AIS) achieve successful reperfusion after the first endovascular thrombectomy (EVT) attempt. In vitro studies have shown that thrombus stiffness influences thrombus-device interaction and retrieval efficacy. This prospective observational study investigates how thrombus stiffness relates to clinical factors, thrombus imaging characteristics and histological composition. It further explores the association between thrombus stiffness and EVT success, as measured by the modified first-pass reperfusion (mFPR).

PATIENTS AND METHODS: A total of 281 thrombus samples were collected from 51 AIS patients undergoing EVT. Thrombus stiffness was quantified using compressive mechanical testing, composition from histological staining and radiological characteristics from pre-interventional non-contrast computed tomography (CT) and CT angiography. Statistical analysis was performed using linear and logistic mixed-effects regression models.

RESULTS: Thrombi retrieved from the proximal M2 segment of the middle cerebral artery showed significant lower stiffness (0.236 kPa, 95% CI, 0.136-0.409) compared to those from the M1 segment (0.760 kPa, 95% CI, 0.492-1.174) and from the ICA (1.106 kPa, 95% CI, 0.558-2.192). Occlusion location was the strongest clinical marker of thrombus stiffness. Adjusted mFPR probability was 40.4% (95% CI, 24.5-67.0) for thrombi retrieved from the ICA, 89.7% (95% CI, 79.5-97.0) for M1 occlusions, and 53.0% (95% CI, 30.8-84.7) for M2 occlusions.

CONCLUSION: Thrombi in distal vessels of the anterior cerebral circulation are significantly softer than those in proximal intracranial arteries. First-pass EVT success is lower for the stiffest thrombi from the ICA and for the softest thrombi from M2, providing a foundation for future biomechanically informed thrombus removal strategies to optimise AIS treatment.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 研究急性缺血性卒中血栓的力学硬度与闭塞位置、影像和组织成分的关系，并探索其与机械取栓首次再灌注成功的关联。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 前瞻性观察研究，从51例接受腔内取栓的患者获得281份血栓样本。以压缩力学试验测量硬度，结合组织染色、术前平扫CT和CTA；使用线性及逻辑混合效应模型处理多个样本等因素。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 近端M2段取出的血栓硬度0.236 kPa（95%CI 0.136–0.409），低于M1段0.760 kPa（0.492–1.174）及颈内动脉1.106 kPa（0.558–2.192）。闭塞位置是硬度最强的临床标志。校正后的改良首次再灌注成功概率为颈内动脉40.4%、M1 89.7%、M2 53.0%，各有较宽置信区间。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 结果不是“血栓越软越易取出”的单调关系：最硬的颈内动脉及最软的M2血栓成功率均较低。仅51例，取出后力学检测不能直接作为术前决策工具；解剖、器械选择和已取出的血栓样本可能造成混杂及选择偏倚。

43003250.sourceTitle: Prognosis of Patients with Delayed Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Rupture after Endovascular Aortic Repair: A Multicentre Retrospective Study in France.
43003250.sourceAbstract:
OBJECTIVE: The majority of patients with abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) undergo endovascular aortic repair (EVAR). Despite its high overall success rate, EVAR does not eliminate the risk of aneurysm rupture. This study aimed to evaluate the prognosis of patients undergoing surgical management for post-EVAR rupture.

METHODS: A multicentre retrospective study of patients who presented with ruptured AAA after successful EVAR between 2007 and 2022 at 22 academic hospitals was conducted. The index EVAR procedures were performed between 2002 and 2020. Data were extracted from electronic hospital records and computed tomography scans. Death during follow up was ascertained using the French register of deceased persons. Survival probabilities at 30, 90, and 365 days were estimated with Kaplan-Meier estimators. Cox proportional hazards survival regression was used to identify determinants associated with increased risk of death.

RESULTS: One hundred and nine patients (96 men) were included, with a mean age of 79.1 ± 9 years at the time of rupture. The median time from index EVAR to rupture was 50 months (range 0 - 179 months). Sixty-seven patients had open surgery (of which 37% underwent suprarenal cross clamping), 39 received endovascular treatment, and three underwent hybrid repair. Overall mortality was 26.6% at thirty days, increasing to 33.9% at ninety days, and 41.3% at 1 year. Neither the type of endoleak nor the type of repair was significantly associated with risk of death during follow up. Post-operative complications were frequent, including renal complications (44.0%), major haemorrhage (22.9%), respiratory distress (19.3%), and mesenteric ischaemia (6%).

CONCLUSION: This study presented a large multicentre series of patients treated for ruptured AAA after EVAR. Despite considerable progress in stent graft technology, EVAR offers little protection in the event of late rupture, even among patients with type II endoleak only. The mortality rate in this study is within the range of those published based on de novo AAA rupture.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 描述EVAR成功后仍发生迟发腹主动脉瘤破裂、并接受手术处理的患者预后，提醒长期修复成功并不意味着破裂风险消失。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 法国22家学术医院多中心回顾性研究，纳入2007–2022年EVAR后破裂病例，初次EVAR发生于2002–2020年。结合病历、CT和死亡登记，估计30、90、365天生存，使用Cox模型评估死亡相关因素。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 共109例，96名男性，破裂时平均79.1±9岁；首次EVAR至破裂中位50个月（范围0–179）。67例开放、39例腔内、3例杂交修复。30天死亡率26.6%，90天33.9%，1年41.3%。内漏类型和修复方式均未与随访死亡风险呈显著关联。肾脏并发症44.0%、大出血22.9%、呼吸窘迫19.3%、肠系膜缺血6%。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 研究只分析已破裂并接受处理的患者，不能据此计算所有EVAR患者的迟发破裂发生率，也不能评价EVAR与开放手术的总体优劣。治疗选择、年代及病例严重程度可能混杂；不同修复方式未达显著差异不等于疗效相同。

43008844.sourceTitle: The IMA-PLUS Score for Predicting Type 2 Endoleak After Endovascular Repair: Development and External Validation in European and Japanese Cohorts.
43008844.sourceAbstract:
OBJECTIVE: Prophylactic embolisation of infrarenal branch vessels has been investigated to prevent type 2 endoleak (EL2) following endovascular repair (EVAR) of abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAA), but patient selection is poorly defined. In this study, a computed tomography angiography (CTA) based risk score was developed and validated to predict EL2 after EVAR.

METHODS: This multicentre, retrospective diagnostic study used prospectively collected data from the Zenith alpha for aneurysm Repair Registry (ZEPHYR) as the development cohort. Eligible patients underwent standard EVAR with pre-operative arterial phase CTA and at least one post-operative delayed phase CTA. The model was converted into a numerical score ("IMA-PLUS Score") and validated in two retrospective cohorts. Discrimination, calibration, and risk group thresholds were assessed. In validation cohorts, freedom from AAA expansion and EL2 associated reinterventions up to 5 years were analysed.

RESULTS: Data from 245 patients of the ZEPHYR registry were included. EL2 occurred in 96 patients (39.2%). The IMA-PLUS Score includes inferior mesenteric artery diameter, number of infrarenal renal pole arteries, number of patent lumbar arteries, and median sacral artery patency, achieving a crossvalidated area under the curve (AUC) of 0.78. Using prespecified thresholds (low < 128, medium 128 - 200, high > 200), observed EL2 incidences in ZEPHYR were 19%, 59%, and 74%. In the Heidelberg cohort (n = 134; EL2 44%), AUC was 0.77 (95% confidence intervals [CI] 0.69 - 0.85) with EL2 incidences of 24%, 60%, and 89% across risk groups with good calibration; interobserver agreement for total score was high (intraclass correlation coefficient of 0.95). In the Tokyo cohort (n = 123; EL2 52.8%) AUC was 0.75 (95% CI 0.67 - 0.84); EL2 incidences were 36%, 76%, and 80%, with higher observed incidence than predicted. In validation cohorts, the IMA-PLUS Score was associated with AAA expansion and reduced freedom from EL2 associated reinterventions.

CONCLUSION: The IMA-PLUS Score may support selection of patients for future studies on preventive management strategies.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 建立并外部验证一项基于术前CTA的IMA-PLUS评分，预测标准EVAR术后的II型内漏，为未来预防性处理研究中的患者选择提供依据。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 利用ZEPHYR登记库245名患者开发评分，并在海德堡134人和东京123人两个回顾性队列验证。评分纳入肠系膜下动脉直径、肾下肾极动脉数量、通畅腰动脉数量及骶正中动脉通畅性；同时分析区分度、校准、观察者一致性及最长5年的瘤体扩张和相关再干预。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 开发队列II型内漏发生率39.2%，交叉验证AUC为0.78。预设低、中、高风险组的内漏率分别为19%、59%、74%。海德堡验证AUC为0.77，东京为0.75；总评分观察者间一致性ICC为0.95。东京队列实际发生率高于预测值，提示校准存在人群差异。评分还与瘤体扩张及内漏相关再干预有关。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 该评分可能帮助设计和选择预防性管理研究对象，但并未直接证明按该评分实施预防性栓塞能改善结局。其阈值、人群适用性及不同中心校准情况仍需核对原文并进一步验证。
