43013818.sourceTitle: Prevention of Venous Thromboembolism after Total Hip or Knee Replacement.
43013818.sourceAbstract:
BACKGROUND: Studies comparing aspirin with anticoagulants for venous thromboembolism (VTE) prophylaxis after total hip or knee arthroplasty have had conflicting results.

METHODS: In a comparative-effectiveness noninferiority trial, we randomly assigned patients undergoing elective hip or knee arthroplasty to receive aspirin (81 mg twice daily), warfarin (to a target international normalized ratio of 2.0), or rivaroxaban (10 mg daily) for 30 days. The composite primary effectiveness outcome (death from any cause or symptomatic VTE) and primary safety outcome (bleeding, reoperation for wound problems, or myocardial infarction) were evaluated through 6 months in a blinded fashion. The noninferiority margin for the risk difference was 0.69 percentage points.

RESULTS: Among 18,883 participants who had undergone randomization, 15,317 (7214 with hip arthroplasty and 8103 with knee arthroplasty) were included in the primary per-protocol analysis. A primary effectiveness outcome event occurred in 77 of 6090 participants (1.26%) in the aspirin group, in 52 of 4231 (1.23%) in the warfarin group, and in 47 of 4996 (0.94%) in the rivaroxaban group; a primary safety outcome event occurred in 177 (2.91%), 142 (3.36%), and 174 (3.48%), respectively. In pairwise comparisons, 6-month risks of a primary effectiveness outcome event were 1.24% and 0.94% for aspirin versus rivaroxaban (difference, 0.30 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI], -0.20 to 0.81); 1.24% and 1.01% for aspirin versus warfarin (difference, 0.23 percentage points; 95% CI, -0.34 to 0.81); and 1.13% and 1.10% for warfarin versus rivaroxaban (difference, 0.03 percentage points; 95% CI, -0.57 to 0.63). Risks of a primary safety outcome event were 3.70% and 3.02% for rivaroxaban versus aspirin (difference, 0.68 percentage points; 95% CI, -0.04 to 1.41); 3.65% and 2.88% for warfarin versus aspirin (difference, 0.77 percentage points; 95% CI, -0.04 to 1.58); and 3.59% and 3.61% for rivaroxaban versus warfarin (difference, -0.02 percentage points; 95% CI, -0.89 to 0.85). Intention-to-treat analyses yielded similar results.

CONCLUSIONS: Aspirin prophylaxis after total hip or knee arthroplasty was not noninferior to rivaroxaban or warfarin with respect to death or symptomatic VTE. Warfarin and rivaroxaban were not noninferior to aspirin for safety. (Funded by the Patient-Centered Outcomes Research Institute; PEPPER ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT02810704.).

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 比较择期髋或膝关节置换术后，阿司匹林、华法林和利伐沙班预防静脉血栓栓塞（VTE）的效果与安全性，重点不是简单比较发生率，而是检验预设的非劣效性假设。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 这项比较效果非劣效性随机试验将患者分配至阿司匹林81 mg每日两次、华法林（目标INR为2.0）或利伐沙班10 mg每日一次，治疗30天。主要疗效终点为全因死亡或症状性VTE，主要安全终点包括出血、伤口问题再次手术或心肌梗死，随访评估至6个月；风险差的非劣效界值为0.69个百分点。共18883人随机分组，主要符合方案分析纳入15317人。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 符合方案人群中，三组主要疗效事件依次为77/6090（1.26%）、52/4231（1.23%）和47/4996（0.94%）；主要安全事件依次为2.91%、3.36%和3.48%。两两比较中，阿司匹林对利伐沙班的6个月主要疗效风险差为0.30个百分点（95%CI -0.20至0.81），对华法林为0.23个百分点（-0.34至0.81）。意向治疗分析得到相似结果。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 原摘要结论是：在死亡或症状性VTE方面，未证明阿司匹林对利伐沙班或华法林具有非劣效性；在安全性方面，也未证明华法林或利伐沙班对阿司匹林具有非劣效性。这里的“未证明非劣效”不能改写成“已证明某药全面更好”或“已证明等效”；需结合非劣效界值、置信区间和具体分析人群理解。

43014502.sourceTitle: Training Structure and Satisfaction with Learning in European Vascular Surgery Training: Results from the European Vascular Surgery Training (EVaST) Surveys.
43014502.sourceAbstract:
OBJECTIVE: This study describes the availability of modifiable structural training elements across European vascular surgery programmes to identify which of these elements are independently associated with trainees' satisfaction with learning and to contextualise them with trainer reported delivery constraints.

METHODS: The study comprised two parallel cross-sectional web based European Vascular Surgery Training (EVaST) surveys of trainees and trainers. The main outcome variable was satisfaction with learning (10 point Likert scale). Five modifiable structural elements were identified a priori: structured curriculum; training coordinator; dedicated or protected training time; assigned mentor; and simulation access. Associations were examined using an adjusted linear mixed effects model (LMM), with secondary models for coordinator resourcing and mentorship evaluations. Trainer data were analysed descriptively.

RESULTS: Of 420 trainee responses (32 countries), 273 entered the complete case main LMM. Availability was inconsistent: structured curriculum 56.4%; dedicated or protected training time 34.3%; and simulation access 32.3%. In the adjusted LMM, learning satisfaction was higher with a structured curriculum (= 0.79, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.21 - 1.38; p = .008) and dedicated training time (= 0.62, 95% CI 0.05 - 1.19; p = .035). In secondary models, coordinators with dedicated educational time showed the largest association (= 1.76, 95% CI 1.05 - 2.46; p < .001), and mentorship with regular evaluations was associated with higher satisfaction (= 0.98, 95% CI 0.36 - 1.59; p = .002). Among 659 trainers (37 countries), mentorship importance was rated 8.26 out of 10, yet only 43.4% had dedicated mentorship time; the dominant barrier was clinical workload (84.1%). Desired improvements were dedicated mentorship time (64.4%), formalised programmes (54.3%), and regular feedback sessions (51.6%).

CONCLUSION: A structured curriculum and dedicated training time were independently associated with higher trainee learning satisfaction across European vascular surgery programmes. Organisational roles such as training coordinators and mentors were associated with higher satisfaction in exploratory secondary analyses, suggesting these roles may be most beneficial when actively resourced with dedicated time and regular evaluations. Trainer constraints converged on protected time for training and mentorship.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 了解欧洲血管外科培训中可改进的组织结构，并分析课程、保护性培训时间、协调员、导师与模拟训练条件和学员学习满意度的关系。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 两项平行的横断面网络调查，分别面向学员和带教者。主要结局是10分制学习满意度；预设5项结构要素，使用校正线性混合效应模型，协调员资源和导师评价为次级探索分析。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 学员回复420份、涉及32国，主模型完整病例273人。56.4%有结构化课程、34.3%有专门/保护性培训时间、32.3%可用模拟训练。结构化课程与满意度高0.79分相关（95%CI 0.21–1.38），专门培训时间高0.62分（0.05–1.19）。次级分析中，协调员有专门教学时间及导师有定期评价分别与高1.76分、0.98分相关。659名带教者中43.4%有专门导师时间，84.1%指出临床工作量是主要障碍。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 研究主题是医学教育，不是患者治疗疗效。横断面自报调查不能证明增加某种培训设置必然提高满意度，更不能证明改善手术质量；完整病例比例、回应偏倚及不同国家制度差异均需考虑。

43018062.sourceTitle: Effects of Exercise Preconditioning on Promoting Endogenous Recovery Responses After Ischemic Stroke in Late-Adult Mice.
43018062.sourceAbstract:
BACKGROUND: Ischemic stroke causes substantial neurological impairment, and although poststroke rehabilitation can support recovery, neurological deficits often limit the feasibility of exercise in clinical settings. Prestroke exercise has emerged as a potential strategy to enhance resilience to ischemic injury, but most preclinical studies have relied on young adult rodents, in which spontaneous recovery can sometimes obscure clinically meaningful functional effects. However, the impact of exercise preconditioning in later stages of adulthood remains insufficiently characterized. Here, we investigated whether a treadmill exercise preconditioning regimen confers neuroprotection and improves recovery-related responses in late-adult mice subjected to middle cerebral artery occlusion.

METHODS: Eight-month-old male mice were assigned to sedentary or exercise groups. Following 5 weeks of treadmill running (5 days per week after 1 week of acclimatization), mice underwent 45 minutes of middle cerebral artery occlusion and reperfusion. Behavioral assessments and body-weight monitoring were performed before and after middle cerebral artery occlusion. Infarct volume and cellular responses were evaluated 14 days after stroke.

RESULTS: Fourteen days after stroke, lesion volume was significantly reduced in the exercise group compared with sedentary controls. Exercise preconditioning enhanced neurogenesis, oligodendrogenesis, and CD31-positive vascular responses while suppressing reactive astrocyte activation. Functional improvements were consistently observed across multiple behavioral assays in late-adult mice.

CONCLUSIONS: Preconditioning with treadmill exercise provides neuroprotection against ischemic stroke in late-adult mice by reducing infarct volume and promoting recovery-associated cellular responses. These findings demonstrate that the functional benefits of prestroke exercise extend beyond the young adult stage and support the potential value of regular physical activity as a strategy to mitigate ischemic brain injury later in adulthood.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 针对既往卒中运动预适应研究多用青年啮齿动物的问题，评估较晚成年阶段小鼠卒中前跑台训练能否减轻缺血损伤并促进恢复。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 8月龄雄性小鼠分为静息与运动组，经1周适应后，每周5天、共5周跑台训练，再接受45分钟大脑中动脉闭塞及再灌注。术前术后评估行为和体重，卒中14天时检测梗死体积及细胞反应。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 运动预适应组14天梗死体积较静息组减少，多项行为学测试改善。神经发生、少突胶质细胞生成及CD31阳性血管反应增强，反应性星形胶质细胞激活减弱。摘要未给出各效应的具体数值、置信区间及样本量。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 这是雄性小鼠的卒中前干预，不是患者卒中后的运动处方，也不是氢气治疗研究。细胞标志物增加不自动等于恢复了完整神经血管功能；临床转化仍需考虑性别、年龄、合并症、运动剂量及可实施时间窗。

43018065.sourceTitle: Predictors of Clinically Meaningful 1-Year Health Status Improvements Following Endovascular or Surgical Revascularization: Insights From the BEST-CLI Trial.
43018065.sourceAbstract:
BACKGROUND: Despite efforts to promote limb salvage in chronic limb-threatening ischemia (CLTI), the factors associated with meaningful health status improvement after revascularization remain poorly understood. We examined predictors of meaningful 1-year health status improvement following revascularization for CLTI.

METHODS: We pooled endovascular and surgical arms from the BEST-CLI (Best Endovascular Versus Best Surgical Therapy in Patients With CLTI) randomized controlled trial, including patients with CLTI (150 international sites, 2014-2019). Health status was assessed at baseline and 1 year using the peripheral artery disease-specific Vascular Quality of Life questionnaire, the generic European Quality-of-Life 5 Dimensions, and the Short Form-12 Physical and Mental Component Summary. Distribution-based minimal clinically important difference thresholds were defined as 0.5 SD of baseline health status scores. Multivariable logistic regression identified predictors of no meaningful 1-year improvement (same/worsened versus improved).

RESULTS: Among 1017 patients (72.0% men, mean age 66.8±9.7 years), clinically meaningful improvements were reported by 76.5% for Vascular Quality of Life, 52.8% European Quality-of-Life 5 Dimensions, 56.7% for Short Form-12 Physical Component Summary, and 42.1% for Short Form-12 Mental Component Summary, regardless of revascularization type (surgical versus endovascular). Cardiometabolic risk factors and higher preprocedural health status increased the odds of no meaningful improvement. Revascularization type was not associated with Vascular Quality of Life improvement (odds ratio, 1.059 [95% CI, 0.91-1.23]; P=0.445; C statistic=0.77).

CONCLUSIONS: One-year postrevascularization, over three-fourths of individuals with CLTI perceived meaningful improvements in peripheral artery disease-specific health, and over half improved overall physical health, regardless of procedure type. Cardiometabolic risk factors and higher preprocedural health status predicted 1-year health status response. REGISTRATION: URL: https://clinicaltrials.gov; Unique identifier: NCT02060630.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 在慢性肢体威胁性缺血（CLTI）患者中，寻找血运重建后1年健康状态达到有临床意义改善的预测因素，而非只关注保肢和血管通畅。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 合并BEST-CLI随机试验的腔内与外科组，分析150个国际中心的1017例患者。基线及1年评估血管疾病特异性生活质量、EQ-5D及SF-12身心维度；将基线评分标准差的0.5倍作为最小临床重要差异，用多变量模型识别未改善因素。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 平均年龄66.8±9.7岁，72.0%男性。1年达到有意义改善的比例分别为血管生活质量76.5%、EQ-5D 52.8%、SF-12躯体56.7%、心理42.1%。心代谢危险因素及较高术前健康评分与未达到改善相关。重建方式与血管生活质量改善无显著关联（OR 1.059，95%CI 0.91–1.23；P=0.445），该预测模型C统计量0.77。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 这是试验数据的合并预测分析，并不是证明两种治疗在所有结局上等效。改善阈值由分布法定义，术前评分高也可能限制可改善空间；应核对随访缺失、患者选择和各量表差异。不能将生活质量结论直接外推到保肢、死亡或再次干预。

43028342.sourceTitle: Continuous Near-Infrared Spectroscopy as a Real-Time Monitor of Intravenous Thrombolysis in Acute Ischaemic Stroke: A Prospective Observational Emergency Department Study.
43028342.sourceAbstract: Background. Intravenous (IV) thrombolysis is the standard of care for acute ischaemic stroke (AIS), yet there is still no objective bedside tool for monitoring the brain continuously during the infusion. Near-infrared spectroscopy (NIRS) provides non-invasive, continuous measurement of regional cerebral oxygen saturation (rSO2). We evaluated whether bilateral frontal NIRS, and in particular the absolute interhemispheric difference in rSO2 (ΔNIRS), tracks the clinical trajectory of patients receiving IV alteplase in the emergency department (ED). Methods. A prospective observational cohort study was conducted in the ED of a tertiary university hospital. Consecutive adults receiving IV alteplase for AIS were screened, and those enrolled underwent continuous bilateral frontal NIRS monitoring. Bilateral rSO2, ΔNIRS, vital signs, Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) and National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale (NIHSS) were recorded at baseline and at 0, 15, 30, 45, 60 and 120 min after the start of the infusion. Patients were classified by clinical trajectory during monitoring as improvement, no change, or deterioration. Results. Forty-one patients were analyzed (26 female, 63.4%; mean age 73.6 ± 14.8 years); 15 (36.6%) improved, 21 (51.2%) showed no change and 5 (12.2%) deteriorated. In the whole cohort, absolute rSO2 rose only slightly in the affected hemisphere and did not change in the unaffected hemisphere. However, affected-hemisphere rSO2 rose significantly in the improvement group (median 59 to 67; p = 0.001) and fell significantly in the deterioration group (p = 0.015). ΔNIRS narrowed from a median of 4 (IQR 3-9) at baseline to 1 (IQR 0-5) at 120 min in the improvement group (p = 0.034) and did not change significantly in the other groups. The two patients with acute complications desaturated bilaterally. NIHSS correlated strongly and inversely with GCS at every time point (ρ = -0.74 to -0.84; all p < 0.001). Conclusions. During IV thrombolysis in the ED, continuous bilateral frontal NIRS tracked the clinical trajectory. Because recanalisation and reperfusion were not assessed independently, what NIRS paralleled was the clinical course, not reperfusion itself. These hypothesis-generating findings warrant larger studies that validate ΔNIRS against perfusion or vascular imaging.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 观察双侧额部近红外光谱（NIRS）脑氧监测及两半球氧饱和度差值ΔNIRS，能否在急诊静脉阿替普酶输注期间反映临床变化。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 单中心前瞻性观察队列，41例急性缺血性卒中患者连续监测双侧rSO2，并在基线及输注后0、15、30、45、60、120分钟记录生命体征、GCS及NIHSS。按临床过程分为改善15例、无变化21例、恶化5例。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 改善组患侧rSO2中位数由59升至67（P=0.001），恶化组显著下降（P=0.015）。改善组ΔNIRS由基线4（IQR 3–9）缩至120分钟1（0–5，P=0.034），其他组未显著变化。两名急性并发症患者双侧脑氧下降。总体患者平均73.6±14.8岁，63.4%为女性。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 没有独立血管再通或灌注影像验证，监测反映的是临床轨迹，不能声称直接测到了再灌注成功。样本仅41例、恶化5例，不能确定预警阈值、诊断准确性或监测能否改善结局，需更大研究与影像对照。

43028396.sourceTitle: The Need for Device-Specific Training Before Handheld Ultrasound Use: Agreement and Repeatability of Simulated Aortic Aneurysm Diameter Measurements by Senior Sonography Students on a Familiar Conventional and an Unfamiliar Handheld System.
43028396.sourceAbstract: Background: Ultrasound measurement of abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) diameter guides screening and surveillance, but whether students' measurement competence on a conventional system transfers to an unfamiliar handheld device has rarely been assessed. Methods: Twenty-seven senior sonography students made three anteroposterior outer-to-outer measurements of two water-filled balloons embedded in gelatin (reference diameters 3.53 and 5.88 cm, calculated from the circumference before embedding), first on the familiar cart-based conventional system and then, in a fixed, non-randomised order, on a handheld system with which they had no prior hands-on experience. The primary outcomes were bias against the calculated reference, with equivalence testing (±5%), and the paired between-system difference, with Bland-Altman analysis; repeatability was assessed with repeatability coefficients. Results: Conventional measurements were equivalent to the calculated reference within ±5% (bias -0.09 cm, 95% CI -0.16 to -0.02; +0.07 cm, 95% CI -0.05 to +0.19). Handheld measurements were higher (+0.17 and +0.33 cm; both p < 0.001) and failed equivalence; the mean between-system difference was +0.26 cm (95% CI 0.18-0.34), without proportional bias. Single-reading repeatability coefficients were 0.31-0.67 cm. Conclusions: Students' conventional-system measurements agreed closely with the calculated reference, although this reference was not verified after embedding. Because device type was confounded with operator inexperience and with a fixed testing order, which introduces an unquantifiable learning or fatigue effect, the 0.26 cm value is an observed between-system difference under the study conditions and cannot be attributed to the handheld device itself. Measurement competence did not transfer automatically to a new device, underlining the critical need for device-specific training before handheld systems are used for aortic measurement. These implications are educational and technical; phantom findings do not support clinical surveillance recommendations without confirmation in patients.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 检验学生在常规超声设备上掌握的腹主动脉瘤直径测量能力，能否直接迁移到从未使用过的手持设备。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 27名高年级超声学生对包埋于明胶的两个充水球囊各作3次前后径外缘到外缘测量。参考直径3.53和5.88 cm由包埋前周长换算。按固定非随机顺序先用熟悉的台车设备、再用陌生手持设备；以±5%作等效界限，分析偏倚、一致性与重复性。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 常规设备测量落在等效界限内，对两种模型的偏倚为−0.09和+0.07 cm；手持设备测量分别偏高+0.17、+0.33 cm，未达到等效。设备间平均差+0.26 cm（95%CI 0.18–0.34），单次测量重复性系数0.31–0.67 cm。

sections.heading: 结论与局限

43030387.sourceTitle: Self-Expanding Stent-Assisted Reconstruction of Distal Supra-Aortic Vessels in Acute Type A Aortic Dissection: A Comparative Analysis.
43030387.sourceAbstract: Background: Supra-aortic vessel reconstruction during total aortic arch replacement in acute Stanford type A aortic dissection patients with dissected distal supra-aortic vessels remains technically challenging; proximal supra-aortic vessel replacement alone carries a high risk of neurological complications secondary to intimal inversion. This study aims to evaluate clinical outcomes of self-expanding stent-assisted supra-aortic vessel reconstruction compared with proximal replacement of supra-aortic vessels alone. Methods and Results: We performed a single-center retrospective comparative analysis of 49 consecutive patients undergoing emergency total aortic arch replacement for acute Stanford type A aortic dissection from January 2022 to December 2023. Patients were divided into two groups according to intraoperative anatomy and surgeon decision: self-expanding stent-assisted supra-aortic vessel reconstruction (SAVR, n = 26) and proximal replacement of supra-aortic vessels alone (PRVA, n = 23). Neurological outcomes related to supra-aortic vessel intimal inversion, operative parameters, blood product transfusion, and short-term complications were analyzed. The mean follow-up was 18.2 ± 4.1 months (range, 12-24 months). The SAVR group exhibited significantly lower supra-aortic vessel stenosis rate (3.8% vs. 30.4%, p < 0.001) and zero cases of intimal inversion-related luminal collapse versus five cases in the PRVA group (0 vs. 5, p = 0.02). Numerically fewer cases of symptomatic stroke (0% vs. 8.7%, p = 0.09) and radiographic cerebral infarction (3.8% vs. 13.0%, p = 0.17) were observed in the SAVR group, though the differences did not achieve statistical significance. Red blood cell and fresh frozen plasma transfusion requirements, mechanical ventilation duration, and ICU stay length were significantly lower in the SAVR cohort. Cardiopulmonary bypass time and 30-day mortality were comparable between groups. Conclusions: Self-expanding stent-assisted supra-aortic vessel reconstruction represents a promising technical option during total arch replacement for acute Stanford type A aortic dissection with distal supra-aortic dissection, associated with superior branch vessel patency and favorable numerical trends in neurological and recovery-related endpoints, with a comparable early-term safety profile. Potential benefits require further validation in larger cohorts.

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 支架组分支血管狭窄率为3.8%，对照组为30.4%；内膜翻转相关管腔塌陷为0例与5例。支架组症状性卒中（0%与8.7%，p=0.09）及影像学脑梗死（3.8%与13.0%，p=0.17）数值较少，但未达到统计学显著性。输血需求、机械通气及ICU停留时间较低，体外循环时间和30天死亡率相近。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 该方法是值得进一步验证的技术选择，但不能把神经系统终点的数值趋势写成已证实降低卒中。研究样本小、非随机，分组受解剖和术者选择影响；其潜在获益仍需更大队列验证。

43033162.sourceTitle: Mortality Following Recurrent Venous Thromboembolism and Major Bleeding Stratified by Active Cancer Status.
43033162.sourceAbstract:
BACKGROUND: Recurrent venous thromboembolism (VTE) and major bleeding are serious complications after acute VTE. However, their independent impact on subsequent mortality in the era of direct oral anticoagulants remains unclear, particularly with respect to differences between patients with and without active cancer.

OBJECTIVES: The aim of this study was to evaluate the associations of recurrent VTE and major bleeding with subsequent mortality in the overall cohort and subgroups stratified by active cancer.

METHODS: We analyzed 5,197 patients with VTE from the COMMAND VTE Registry-2 using multivariable Cox proportional hazards models with recurrent VTE and major bleeding as time-updated covariates.

RESULTS: In the overall cohort, 283 patients developed recurrent VTE, 470 developed major bleeding, and 1,323 died. Recurrent VTE and major bleeding were associated with mortality (adjusted HR: 1.65, 95% CI: 1.28-2.12, P < 0.001; adjusted HR: 3.33, 95% CI: 2.83-3.91, P < 0.001, respectively). Among patients with active cancer, both recurrent VTE and major bleeding were associated with mortality (adjusted HR: 1.95, 95% CI: 1.45-2.62, P < 0.001; adjusted HR: 2.96, 95% CI: 2.42-3.61, P < 0.001, respectively). Among patients without active cancer, only major bleeding was associated with mortality (adjusted HR: 3.78, 95% CI: 2.88-4.97, P < 0.001), whereas recurrent VTE was not associated with mortality (adjusted HR: 0.93, 95% CI: 0.55-1.56, P = 0.78).

CONCLUSIONS: In contemporary real-world patients with VTE in the era of direct oral anticoagulants, major bleeding was associated with increased subsequent mortality in both patients with and without active cancer, whereas recurrent VTE was associated with increased mortality in patients with active cancer, with no significant association observed in those without active cancer.

sections.heading: 研究目的
sections.text: 评价急性VTE后的血栓复发和大出血与后续死亡的关系，并区分有活动性肿瘤和无活动性肿瘤患者。

sections.heading: 研究方法
sections.text: 分析COMMAND VTE Registry-2登记库5197名VTE患者，将复发VTE和大出血作为随时间变化的协变量，使用多变量Cox模型分析死亡关联，并按活动性肿瘤状态分层。

sections.heading: 主要结果
sections.text: 总体有283例复发VTE、470例大出血和1323例死亡。复发VTE及大出血与死亡相关，校正HR分别为1.65和3.33。活动性肿瘤患者中，两者均与死亡相关，HR分别为1.95和2.96。无活动性肿瘤患者中，大出血仍与死亡相关（HR 3.78，95%CI 2.88—4.97），而VTE复发未见显著关联（HR 0.93，0.55—1.56；p=0.78）。

sections.heading: 结论与局限
sections.text: 在直接口服抗凝药应用背景下，大出血在两类患者中都与更差生存相关，而复发VTE的死亡关联因肿瘤状态而异。登记研究展示的是观察性关联；不能据此独立确定某一种抗凝方案，也不能把无肿瘤亚组的不显著结果解释为复发VTE没有临床危害。
